title: How to Invite People to Zoom Meeting
subtitle: How to Invite People to Zoom Meeting: Click on Host, Select Launch Meeting, Click on Participants, Click on Invite, Select Copy Invitation
author: Techcult
summary: How to Invite People to Zoom Meeting: Click on Host, Select Launch Meeting, Click on Participants, Click on Invite, Select Copy Invitation
content:
Zoom has become a popular video conference platform for conducting remote meetings or getting on a call with hundreds of people at once. We all know that creating a Zoom meeting and inviting everyone is not a complicated task. However, not many users know all the different ways you can ask someone to join your call. So, let’s see how to invite people to a Zoom meeting and make sure no one misses out on important meetings!

  • How to Invite People to Zoom Meeting
  • Method 1: Via Invite Link
  • Method 2: Via Contacts
  • Method 3: Via Email
  • Method 4: Via Scheduled Meetings
  • Is There a Limit to How Many People You Can Invite to a Zoom Meeting?
  • Can People Without a Zoom Account Join a Zoom Meeting?

How to Invite People to Zoom Meeting

Now you can easily connect with people and make sure your online interactions are not interrupted by any delays. Stay tuned until the end to check out different ways you can invite users.

Method 1: Via Invite Link

The easiest way to ask people to join a meeting is by sending them a copy of invite links from Zoom.

  1. Log in to your Zoom account and click on Home from the left menu.
  2. Click on Host from the right window.
  3. Select Launch Meeting.
  4. Click on Participants at the bottom ribbon.
  5. Then, click on Invite at the bottom left corner from the right menu.
  6. Select Copy Invitation.

Method 2: Via Contacts

If you have contacts synced in your Zoom, you can directly invite them to join.

  1. Open Zoom > Home > Host > Launch Meeting.
  2. Click on Participants.
  3. Select Invite.
  4. Click on Contacts from the top ribbon.
  5. Type in your contacts name in the search box or select users from the results.
  6. Click on Invite.

Method 3: Via Email

Another way is by sending an email to users containing the Zoom meeting information including the invite links.

  1. Follow steps 1-4 from the previous heading Method 2: Via Contacts.
  2. Click on Email from the top ribbon.
  3. Select between Default mail, Gmail, or Yahoo Mail under Choose your email service to send invitation.
  4. Then, type in the email address of the preferred user in the receiver box.
  5. Click on Send.

Your selected user can open their email and join from the invite link they have received.

Method 4: Via Scheduled Meetings

Lastly, you can also schedule meetings for a later date and send invitation links so that people can put them on their calendars and get a notification on the day of the meeting.

  1. Open Zoom > Home.
  2. Click on Schedule from the right window.
  3. Type in the title under Topic.
  4. Select the date and time under When.
  5. Type in the time under Duration.
  6. Type in the usernames or email addresses of your preferred users under Attendees.
  7. Scroll down and click on Save.

The selected people will get your meeting alerts on Zoom and email address.

Is There a Limit to How Many People You Can Invite to a Zoom Meeting?

Yes, the limit to invite people depends on your Zoom plan. The Basic plan allows up to 100 participants, while with Pro membership you can invite 100 participants. Business and Enterprise plans allow 300 and 500 participants respectively.

Can People Without a Zoom Account Join a Zoom Meeting?

No, participants do not need a Zoom account to join a meeting. You can invite them by sharing the meeting link, and they can join from their web browsers or the Zoom app.

Also Read: How to Extend Zoom Meeting Time Limit for Free

By checking out the methods outlined in this guide, we hope that now you have understood how to invite people to a Zoom meeting. Do not hesitate to drop a comment or suggestions in case you have any queries. Keep visiting TechCult to learn more tech-related walkarounds.

title: How to Change Profile Picture on Zoom
subtitle: How to Change Profile Picture on Zoom: Click on the Profile icon, Select Settings, Select Change Picture, Choose an image then Save it
author: Techcult
summary: How to Change Profile Picture on Zoom: Click on the Profile icon, Select Settings, Select Change Picture, Choose an image then Save it
content:
A profile picture is the first thing that people notice. It reflects your personality, interests, and profession. So, having a professional-looking image can help you make a good impression in your Zoom meeting. To learn how to change profile picture on Zoom, read below.

  • How to Change Profile Picture on Zoom
  • How to Change Profile Picture During a Meeting
  • Why is My Zoom Profile Picture Not Updating?
  • Why Does My Profile Picture Appear Differently in Meetings?
  • Why Change Your Profile Picture on Zoom?

How to Change Profile Picture on Zoom

Changing profile picture on Zoom can be a fun and creative way to express your personal style or preferences to virtual meetings and interactions.

Follow these steps to change profile picture on your preferred devices.

On Desktop

  1. Open the Zoom app and sign in with your login credentials.
  2. Click on the Profile icon from the top right corner.
  3. Select Settings.
  4. Click on Profile.
  5. Click on the Pencil icon given above your current profile picture.
  6. Select Change Picture.
  7. Choose an image from your device and adjust the position if needed.
  8. Click on the Save option to set the new profile picture.

On Zoom Website

  1. Save your browser and visit the Zoom login page.
  2. Click on the Profile icon from the top of the screen.
  3. Select the My Profile option.
  4. Click on Profile.
  5. Click on the Edit icon given above your Current profile picture.
  6. Select either Choose Files or Drag and drop files here option.
  7. Once you select the image, click on Save to update your profile picture.

Also Read: How to Change Facebook Marketplace Location to Another Country/Local-Only

On Android

  1. Open the Zoom app.
  2. Tap on the More option from the bottom right corner.
  3. Tap on your Username given next to your profile picture.
  4. Tap on Profile photo.
  5. Select either Take photo or Choose photo option.
  6. Select the image you want to make as your profile picture.
  7. Adjust the photo if needed and tap on the Done icon.

How to Change Profile Picture During a Meeting

Follow these steps to change profile picture during a Zoom meeting:

Note: Make sure to turn off your video to display your profile picture.

  1. Open the Zoom app on your Desktop.
  2. On the Zoom Desktop client, join a Zoom meeting.
  3. During the Zoom meeting, Right-click on your video.
  4. Select the Edit Profile Picture tab.
  5. Then click on Change Picture. Next, select the desired image from your desktop.
  6. Click on Open.
  7. Lastly, click on the Save button.

Why is My Zoom Profile Picture Not Updating?

If you are having trouble updating your profile picture it could be due to the size of the image. If your picture is not smaller than 5 MB and is in JPEG, PNG, or GIF format you will experience difficulty updating your profile picture. Another factor to consider is a potential technical glitch or slow internet connection, which may be preventing the update from going through. In this case, wait for the issue to resolve or try using a different web browser. You can also restart the Zoom app, as this can often resolve any lingering issues with profile picture updates.

Why Does My Profile Picture Appear Differently in Meetings?

There could be several reasons why your profile picture appears differently in meetings including:

  • Low-quality webcam can affect your profile picture look on screen and may appear different.
  • Another reason could be the host may have disabled the profile picture option in the meeting settings, causing a different image to display.
  • Sometimes the profile picture may be cached by the app or browser, leading to a different profile picture.
  • An unstable internet connection can also affect the quality of your profile picture during meetings.

Why Change Your Profile Picture on Zoom?

Changing your profile picture can be an important step if you have a meeting or interview. Having a funny, colored face profile picture could potentially create distractions or questions during your Zoom meeting. It is recommended to use a professional and clear profile picture to convey a more professional image and make a good impression.

Also Read: How to Change Email on Facebook

We hope this article helped you change profile picture on Zoom. Feel free to drop your queries or suggestions in the comments section below. Keep visiting Techcult for more helpful articles.

title: How to Change Background in Zoom App
subtitle: How to Change Background in Zoom App: click on the Profile picture, Select Settings then click on Background & Effects, Select a virtual background
author: Techcult
summary: How to Change Background in Zoom App: click on the Profile picture, Select Settings then click on Background & Effects, Select a virtual background
content:
Upgrade your virtual meetings and interviews with a professional background in Zoom. In this article, we will show you how changing the background in Zoom app can enhance your corporate image and make your video conferencing experience more visually appealing.

  • How to Change Background in Zoom App
  • Method 1: Using Background and Effects feature
  • Method 2: Using Apps feature
  • What to Do If I Don’t Have Virtual Background Option in Zoom?
  • Can I Change the Background on Zoom as a Guest?
  • Is Virtual Background on Zoom Available for Free?
  • What Should Be the Zoom Background Size?

How to Change Background in Zoom App

Changing a background on Zoom is a fun way to personalize your virtual workspace and add some entertainment value to your virtual meetings. Here is the step-by-step guide given to change background in the Zoom application on both Android and Desktop versions.

On Desktop

To change the background in Zoom app before starting a new meeting. You can follow these steps.

  1. Open the Zoom application and click on the Profile picture icon from the top right corner.
  2. Select Settings then click on Background & Effects.
  3. From here select a virtual background or choose your own background.

To change background on Zoom during a meeting follow these steps:

  1. Open the Zoom app and sign in to your account.
  2. Click on New meeting then click on Apps.
  3. Click on Virtual Backgrounds option.
  4. Select the virtual background of your choice.
  5. Then click on Set background.

On Android

Follow these methods if you are on your Android device.

Method 1: Using Background and Effects feature

  1. Open the Zoom app then tap on new meeting.
  2. Tap on Start a meeting then tap on More.
  3. Tap on Background and Effects.
  4. Select the background you want to apply or choose a image from your device gallery.
  5. Once selected, the background will automatically apply.

Also Read: How to Cast a Zoom Meeting to Your TV

Method 2: Using Apps feature

If you are having trouble finding the Background and Effects option to change the background in your app. Don’t worry, there’s another way to do it. Just follow these steps:

  1. Follow the first two steps from method 1.
  2. Now, tap on Apps then tap on the Virtual Backgrounds option.
  3. Find and tap the Background you want to apply to.
  4. Tap on Set background.

That’s it, now the selected background will now be applied to your screen.

What to Do If I Don’t Have Virtual Background Option in Zoom?

If you don’t have the virtual background option in your Zoom app there are several solutions that you can try:

  • Check system requirements: First, ensure that your system meets the requirements for a virtual background.
  • Update Zoom client: Check for the update and install the latest version and ensure to keep your Zoom client up to date.
  • Enable Virtual backgrounds: Ensure to enable the virtual background in Zoom settings.
  • Check your webcam: Check that your webcam is functioning properly and has camera permission.
  • Try signing out: If the issue persists, sign out of the Zoom client and sign in back again.
  • Contact Zoom support: If none of the above solutions work, you can contact Zoom support team.

Can I Change the Background on Zoom as a Guest?

No, it is not possible to change the background on Zoom as a guest. This feature is only available for users who have a Zoom account and are singed in. Guest who joins a meeting without an account do not have access to this feature.

Is Virtual Background on Zoom Available for Free?

Yes, Zoom offers a virtual background feature to all users at no additional cost. This feature allows you to change your background during a video call by replacing your actual background with a different image or video for free.

What Should Be the Zoom Background Size?

The recommended size of Zoom background is 1920 × 1080 pixels with an aspect ratio of 16:9. You can upload images with a maximum file size of 5 MB in JPG/JPEG and PNG format. This ensures that the background image is displayed correctly without any black bars or cropping. However, it is important to note that when you choose to use a PNG format as a Zoom background the transparent areas will show up as white.

Also Read: How To Change Background on LinkedIn

We hope this article was helpful for you and that you have learned how to change the background in Zoom. If you have any queries or suggestions, leave them in the comments section below. Stay tuned to Techcult for more engaging articles.

title: How to Cast a Zoom Meeting to Your TV
subtitle: You can use a Google Chromecast device to cast a Zoom Meeting to your TV from a PC or smartphone. On iOS device, you can use the AirPlay app.
author: Techcult
summary: You can use a Google Chromecast device to cast a Zoom Meeting to your TV from a PC or smartphone. On iOS device, you can use the AirPlay app.
content:
Zoom is now a must-have for people who work from home, take classes online, or host virtual events. Even though computers and smartphones make it easy to join Zoom meetings there are times when you need a bigger screen to see better. In this guide, we’ll cover how you can cast your Zoom meeting from various devices like Android, iOS, and PC to your TV.

  • How to Cast a Zoom Meeting to TV from a Computer
  • Option 1: Use Chromecast
  • Option 2: With an HDMI Cable
  • How to Cast a Zoom Meeting to Your TV on Android or iOS
  • Option 1: Chromecast (Android)
  • Option 2: AirPlay (iOS)
  • Option 3: Using a Wired Connection

How to Cast a Zoom Meeting to TV from a Computer

Option 1: Use Chromecast

Before you start, make sure that your PC and Chromecast are connected to the same Wi-Fi network.

  1. In the Chrome browser, join a Zoom meeting.
  2. Click on the three-dot menu icon and click on Save and share.
  3. Now select Cast.
  4. Select your Chromecast device from the list of available sources.
  5. Choose the Cast desktop to mirror your entire screen or the Cast tab to cast only the Zoom meeting tab.

Option 2: With an HDMI Cable

First, connect one end of the HDMI cable to the computer’s HDMI output port and the other end to the HDMI input port on your TV. Switch your TV’s input source to the corresponding HDMI port. 

Once done, you can join a Zoom meeting on PC, and it will be displayed on your TV.

How to Cast a Zoom Meeting to Your TV on Android or iOS

Option 1: Chromecast (Android)

  1. Plug the Chromecast device into the HDMI port on your TV.
  2. Install the Google Home app on your phone and select an account to sign in.
  3. Tap on the + icon and then on Set up new device.
  4. Navigate to your Wi-Fi settings then tap on Chromecast.
  5. Return to Google Home and tap on Continue.
  6. Confirm the code on your phone if it matches the code on your TV by tapping on I see it.

Option 2: AirPlay (iOS)

For this method, you will need an iOS device with an Apple TV or AirPlay-enabled TV. But before starting, make sure that both of these devices are connected to the same Wi-Fi network.

  1. Open Control Center on your iOS device by swiping it down.
  2. Tap on Screen Mirroring icon.
  3. Select your Apple TV or AirPlay-enabled TV from the list.
    Your iOS device’s screen should now be mirrored on your TV.
  4. Open the Zoom app on your iOS device and join a meeting which will be displayed on your TV.

Option 3: Using a Wired Connection

You’ll need a USB-C to HDMI adapter (for newer Android and iOS devices) or a Lightning to HDMI adapter (for older iOS devices).

Connect the corresponding ends to TV and mobile then switch your TV’s input source to HDMI port. Once mirroring starts then open the Zoom app and join your meeting which will be displayed on the TV.

Also Read: How to Cast Zoom to Roku

So, this is how to cast a Zoom meeting on your TV. If you have any queries or suggestions, do let us know in the comments section below. Stay tuned to Techcult for more helpful guides.

title: How to Extend Zoom Meeting Time Limit for Free
subtitle: How to Extend Zoom Meeting Time Limit for Free: As host, start scheduled meeting. Before meeting ends, leave with all participants & rejoin
author: Techcult
summary: How to Extend Zoom Meeting Time Limit for Free: As host, start scheduled meeting. Before meeting ends, leave with all participants & rejoin
content:
Have you ever been in the middle of an important online class or meeting on Zoom when suddenly your session was automatically terminated? If yes, it might have happened due to the platform’s 40-minute time limit for free users. Missing out on important lessons or discussions in such a way is frustrating, isn’t it? Fortunately, there’s now a solution that can help you out. In this article, we’ll show you how to extend the Zoom meeting time by beating the 40-minute limit for free.

  • How to Extend Zoom Meeting Time Limit for Free
  • Is Zoom’s 40-Minute Limit Removed?
  • How Do I Change My Zoom Time Limit?

How to Extend Zoom Meeting Time Limit for Free

Since Zoom has removed its 40-minute calls, meetings now have to be cut short and rescheduled before they hit their 40-minute timer, causing an inconvenience to everyone including hybrid offices, and schools. But there’s no need to stress about it! Let’s explore in-depth the workarounds for removing this feature and enjoying long meetings with ease!

Quick Answer

Below are the quick steps you can take to extend the Zoom time limit.

1. Open the Zoom desktop app and click on Schedule.

2. Set meeting date and time.

3. Choose Other Calendars and click on Save.

4. Copy the meeting link and share it with participants.

5. Start the meeting and click on Leave Meeting when reaching the 40-minute mark.

6. All participants should exit after the host and rejoin by clicking the invite link to reset the timer.

Is Zoom’s 40-Minute Limit Removed?

No, Zoom’s 40-minute time limit isn’t permanently removed under all circumstances. Some exceptions under which this restriction has been lifted are special events like Christmas, Kwanzaa, and New Year’s so that people can spend time with their families.

Previously, Zoom allowed free users to host meetings lasting up to 24 hours, but this policy changed in July 2022. Now, all meetings conducted by free users, regardless of the number of participants, are subject to the same 40-minute time limit.

Also Read: Is There a Time Limit on Google Meet?

How Do I Change My Zoom Time Limit?

If you want to know how you can beat Zoom’s 40-minute limit, the first thing you can do is buy their subscription plan for Zoom Pro which lets you extend the time limit to 30 hours for up to 100 people. If you are not planning to get premium subscriptions, you can rejoin the meeting with the same link multiple times before it ends. Let’s see how to do so.

Note 1: Make sure you are the meeting host and following this process.

Note 2: This approach is only effective for extending the Zoom meeting time limit for scheduled meetings; not for sudden Zoom meetings.

1. Click on the Schedule option available in the Home tab of the Zoom app.

2. Set the desired date and time for the meeting to generally begin and end.

3. Select the Other Calendars radio button from the Calendar section and click on Save.

4. After saving the meeting, select Copy to Clipboard and send the meeting’s link to other participants.

5. Start your meeting by clicking on Start. A timer will start popping up once the meeting is about to reach 40 minutes.

6. Now, click on Leave Meeting from the meeting window to leave the ongoing meeting. It will help extend the Zoom meeting time limit.

7. After you, the host, is left, all other members should also leave the scheduled meeting.

8. Now, everyone should click on the invite link sent in the first place to join the meeting again. The Zoom timer will reset to 40-minutes again.

By doing so, you might deceive Zoom into believing that you are participating in several brief meetings rather than one lengthy one.

Also Read: How to Bypass LinkedIn Connection Limit

Now, you might know how to extend Zoom meeting time limit for free with the help of this tutorial. You can now enjoy uninterrupted meetings without any time restrictions using this technique. We hope this guide has answered all your questions. If you still have any queries or suggestions, please share them in the comments below. Let us know your thoughts in the comments section, and stay tuned for more insightful articles!

title: How to Fix Zoom Error Code 1142 in Windows 10
subtitle: How to fix Zoom error code 1142 in Windows 10 : Contact Meeting Host or Change Current Location Using a suitable VPN.
author: Techcult
summary: How to fix Zoom error code 1142 in Windows 10 : Contact Meeting Host or Change Current Location Using a suitable VPN.
content:
As virtual communication has become an integral part of our lives in a post-pandemic world, platforms like Zoom have gained unprecedented significance. However, even the most reliable technologies can sometimes falter, and error code 1142 is one such example. Fret not, as in this article, we will discuss different solutions to fix Zoom error code 1142 in Windows 10. 

  • How to Fix Zoom Error Code 1142 in Windows 10
  • Method 1: Restart Zoom
  • Method 2: Contact Meeting Host
  • Method 3: Change Location Using VPN
  • Method 4: Contact Zoom Support
  • Method 5: Reinstall Zoom App

How to Fix Zoom Error Code 1142 in Windows 10

This code indicates that the meeting you’re trying to join is either restricted for participants from your country or region, or the host has specifically permitted entry only for attendees from certain countries. This feature, known as Approve or block entry for users from specific countries/regions, might be the reason behind the appearance of this error. Try the fixes provided in the guide below to get it resolved.

Quick Answer

To get back to Zoom meetings uninterrupted, get host to tweak these settings:

1. Navigate to Zoom Settings and click on Meeting.

2. Scroll down to find Approve or block entry for users from specific countries/regions.

3. Toggle off this setting to allow all regions/countries into the meeting and click on Save.

Method 1: Restart Zoom

To start with, if you are using the Zoom application on your Windows desktop, you must restart it to get the issue fixed. Restarting Zoom will help you get rid of minor glitches. You can end the task on your PC and then start the application back to resume uninterrupted meetings. Please refer to our guide on How to End Task in Windows 10 for more.

Method 2: Contact Meeting Host

To resolve this matter, get in touch with the host of the meeting and ask for access by having them adjust the Approve or block entry for users from specific countries/regions settings. The host can do so by following the below-given steps to fix Zoom error code 1142:

1. Launch Zoom and click on Settings.

2. Click on Meeting.

3. Scroll down to find Approve or block entry for users from specific countries/regions.

4. Either you may toggle off this setting to allow all regions/countries into the meeting.

5. Or you may edit countries to include the country that participants reside in.

6. Click on Save.

Also Read: Where Are Zoom Backgrounds Stored?

Method 3: Change Location Using VPN

A valuable additional solution to tackle Zoom Error Code 1142 is to leverage a VPN (Virtual Private Network). If you find yourself in a situation where the meeting you’re trying to join is restricted to participants from your country or region, a VPN can be a game-changer.

1. Start by choosing a reputable VPN, for this check out some of the best free VPN from our guide.

2. Download and install the VPN software on your device.

3. Connect to a server in a country that is not on the list of blocked countries for the Zoom meeting you want to attend.

Now that your virtual location has been changed, attempt to join the Zoom meeting again. You should no longer encounter this Error, as Zoom will perceive you as joining from an approved location.

Method 4: Contact Zoom Support

Should the problem persist, it’s recommended to reach out to Zoom Support for dedicated troubleshooting aid.

Kindly furnish the following details when submitting your request:

  • Current operating system.
  • A description of your actions leading up to the error occurrence.
  • If applicable, provide the Meeting ID when encountering an error while joining or initiating a meeting.

Also Read: How to Lower Volume Only on Zoom

Method 5: Reinstall Zoom App

When you encounter Zoom error code 1142, a corrupted or damaged installation could be the culprit. This frustrating issue can disrupt your virtual meetings. Therefore, as a last solution, reinstall the app using these steps:

1. Press the Windows key, type Control Panel, and then open it.

2. Select Uninstall a program from the list.

3. Locate Zoom in the list of programs, then click on Uninstall.

4. If a confirmation prompt appears asking if you’re sure about uninstalling Zoom, click Yes.

5. Proceed to install Zoom from the official website or Microsoft Store.

In a world where virtual interactions have become an essential part of our daily lives, encountering errors like Zoom code 1142 can be frustrating. However, with a clear understanding of its meaning and effective troubleshooting solutions that we have explained, you can swiftly overcome this error. If you have any queries or suggestions, do let us know in the comments box below.

title: How to Download Zoom on Apple TV
subtitle: How To Download Zoom on Apple TV : By using Screen Mirroring or AirPlay feature in iPhone, iPad, or Mac system.
author: Techcult
summary: How To Download Zoom on Apple TV : By using Screen Mirroring or AirPlay feature in iPhone, iPad, or Mac system.
content:
Zoom is a highly popular video conferencing platform that can be accessed on a variety of devices for seamless communication. The platform gives you the flexibility to present your important meetings on a larger screen, granting a better visual experience. With this in mind, we will walk you through the steps of downloading Zoom on your Apple TV in this guide.

  • How to Download Zoom on Apple TV
  • Can I Download Zoom on My TV?
  • Method 1: Use Screen Mirroring on iPhone or iPad
  • Method 2: Use Screen Mirroring on Mac

How to Download Zoom on Apple TV

Even though there is no direct way of downloading Zoom on Apple TV, there are a few alternatives that you can try to access this meeting platform on a bigger screen with ease. Let us explore them in detail below.

Can I Download Zoom on My TV?

No, you can not install Zoom on Apple TV. 

As we already know there is no way to download the Zoom app on Apple TV, here are a few methods you can try to use the app on your iOS device.

Method 1: Use Screen Mirroring on iPhone or iPad

Screen Mirroring is the easiest way to get Zoom on Apple TV. To know how to do so, follow the steps below:

1. Open the Control panel on your iPhone or iPad by swiping the screen from top to bottom.

2. Tap on the Screen Mirroring icon.

3. Now, link Apple TV to your iOS device and launch Zoom on your iPhone or iPad.

4. Finally, join the Zoom meeting.

Note: Although Apple TV doesn’t have a webcam, you can use your phone cam and use your TV for a larger view.

Also Read: How to Cast Zoom to TV from iPhone

Method 2: Use Screen Mirroring on Mac

You can also use your Mac to get Zoom on Apple TV. Follow the steps to do so:

1. Open the Browser on your Mac.

2. Open Zoom for Mac and then log in to your account.

3. Click on the Apple menu at the top of the screen.

4. Click on the AirPlay icon and select your Apple Tv from the menu.

Once both devices are connected, you can enjoy Zoom on a bigger screen.

This brings us to the end of our guide on how to download Zoom on Apple TV. If you have any suggestions or queries for us, feel free to drop them in the comment section below.

title: How to Mute Zoom Host on Mac
subtitle: How to Mute Zoom Host on Mac: To do so, click on sound icon present at top of Mac desktop screen. Adjust slider to silence the call sound
author: Techcult
summary: How to Mute Zoom Host on Mac: To do so, click on sound icon present at top of Mac desktop screen. Adjust slider to silence the call sound
content:
Zoom stands out as a prominent application among the others used for virtual meetings. But it can be challenging to ensure seamless communication, especially when background noises come from the host. If you encounter this issue, this guide will instruct you on how to mute the Zoom host on your Mac device with and without muting the computer sound.

  • How to Mute Zoom Host on Mac
  • Method 1: Reduce System Volume
  • Method 2: Ask Host to Mute via Chat
  • How to Mute Zoom on Mac Without Muting Computer?
  • Method 1: Through Zoom Audio Settings
  • Method 2: Leave Computer Audio
  • Method 3: Use Mute All Option (For Hosts & Co-hosts)
  • Method 4: Mute Specific Participants (For Hosts & Co-hosts)

How to Mute Zoom Host on Mac

Muting on Zoom involves silencing your or someone else’s microphone during virtual meetings or calls, reducing background noise and disruptions. But unfortunately, you cannot mute the host on a Zoom call. The host maintains control over their audio, which helps them communicate well and manage the meeting smoothly.

However, you can try the following workarounds to minimize or mute the host’s audio. Let’s see how to so do:

Quick Answer

To mute the host form your Zoom calls on your Mac, you should:

1. Click on the sound icon in Mac’s top menu bar.

2. Slide left the slider to mute system sound, including Zoom calls.

Note: The Mute all option on Zoom will not mute the host or co-hosts. Also, remember only the host or co-host only can use this option.

Method 1: Reduce System Volume

Since you cannot mute the host during the meeting, you can reduce or mute the overall system volume. Follow the below steps to do so:

1. Click on the sound icon from the menu bar at the top of your Mac device.

2. Drag the slider to the left side to mute the system sound.

Note 1: You can also use the F11 key on the keyboard to reduce the volume.

Note 2: You can also lower the volume from the Control Centre.

Method 2: Ask Host to Mute via Chat

If you are comfortable texting the host, you can let the host or co-hosts know about the noise disturbances from their end. Then, you can request them to mute their microphone via the chat box within the Zoom meeting.

Also Read: How to Unmute on Zoom Phone Call

How to Mute Zoom on Mac Without Muting Computer?

If you want to mute Zoom meetings without muting the computer, follow any of the methods listed below accordingly.

Method 1: Through Zoom Audio Settings

Follow the below steps to mute Zoom calls on Mac:

1. During ongoing calls on the Zoom app, click on the upward arrow icon next to the Mute option.

2. Choose Audio Settings…

3. From the Audio tab, drag the Output Volume slider to the leftmost side to mute the Zoom calls.

Method 2: Leave Computer Audio

This method can disconnect your speaker and microphone from the Zoom call. Also, the microphone icon next to your name will disappear so others can know that you have left your device audio.

1. During a Zoom call, click on the upward arrow icon next to the Mute option.

2. Click on Leave Computer Audio.

Also Read: How to Mute Someone on Discord as Admin

Method 3: Use Mute All Option (For Hosts & Co-hosts)

If you are the host or co-host of the Zoom call, you can mute every participant. Follow the below steps:

1. In the Zoom call, click on the Participants tab from the bottom menu bar.

2. Click on Mute All.

Method 4: Mute Specific Participants (For Hosts & Co-hosts)

The host and co-hosts can also mute specific participants whose background noise is too high and disturbing. Follow the below steps to do so:

1. Click on the Participants tab from the bottom bar.

2. Click on the Mute option next to the desired participant’s name whom you want to mute.

This will mute the user indicated by the crossed-out red microphone icon.

Also Read: How to Add a Host to Facebook Event

Through this guide, we have presented you with various methods on how to mute Zoom host on Mac with and without muting your computer. Now, you can manage your Zoom meetings more effectively and ensure smoother communication. If you have any questions or suggestions to share about more Zoom topics, don’t hesitate to drop a comment below. Stay tuned to our website for more helpful guides. Until next time!

content:
Zoom, a video conferencing platform, provides its users with the option to use virtual backgrounds during their calls. With this, you can replace the actual backdrop with a stunning image or video to add a touch of personalization to your calls. But have you ever wondered where are zoom background stored? In this article, we will discuss the answer to this question and provide you with a step-by-step guide on how to use them as well.

  • Where are Zoom Backgrounds Stored?
  • Can You Use Custom Backgrounds in Zoom?
  • How to Use Custom Zoom Backgrounds
  • What Are the Benefits of Custom Zoom Backgrounds?

Where are Zoom Backgrounds Stored?

Zoom backgrounds are a feature that allows you to display an image or video as a presentable background during virtual meetings. The location where these are stored depends on the device you are using. To know exactly where can they be found, please keep reading the guide.

Can You Use Custom Backgrounds in Zoom?

Yes, it is possible to use custom backgrounds on Zoom. By adding them, you can enhance the visual appearance of your meeting. 

1. The Default Zoom backgrounds on macOS and Windows are stored in the following location:

Windows: C:\Users\USER_NAME\ApData\Roaming\Zoom\data\VirtualBkgnd_Default/.

macOS: /Users/USER_NAME/Library/Application

Support/zoom.us/data/VirtualBkgnd_Custom.

2. The Custom backgrounds on macOS devices and Windows are stored in the following location:

macOS: /Users/USER_NAME/Library/Application

Support/zoom.us/data/VirtualBkgnd_Custom

Window: C:\Users\USER_NAME\AppData\Roaming\Zoom\data\VirtualBkgnd_Custom

Also Read: Where are My Facebook Notes

How to Use Custom Zoom Backgrounds

Now that you know where Zoom backgrounds are stored, you can use custom ones by following these steps:

1. Open the Zoom application on your PC and log into your account.

2. From the top right corner click on your Profile icon.

3. From the list of options select Settings.

4. Under the General section, click on the Background & Effects option.

Note: Select any background of your choice from available Backgrounds.

5. If you are uploading your custom background, click on the Plus icon.

6. Click on Add Image.

Note: Select any image to set as your custom background from your PC.

Once you have selected your custom background, it will be applied in the virtual background settings.

Also Read: How to Blur Background in Zoom

What Are the Benefits of Custom Zoom Backgrounds?

There are numerous benefits of using custom Zoom backgrounds such as:

  • It helps you hide any potential distractions or mess in your living room.
  • With virtual background, you can create a more professional look and maintain privacy.
  • It helps employees choose an image that represents their personality, allowing them to develop better relationships with others.
  • It helps businesses to increase brand recognition among a large number of people during meetings or webinars, this is beneficial for businesses to attract potential customers.
  • It helps you leave a lasting impression on participants by adding a touch of creativity to your Zoom meeting.

Adding custom backgrounds is a fun and creative way to personalize your virtual meetings. We hope this article helped you with the same and revealed where are Zoom backgrounds stored. title: How to Share Disney Plus on Zoom
subtitle: How to Share Disney Plus on Zoom : Start or join a meeting in Zoom, tap on Share to start casting and open Disney + app to stream a movie.
author: Techcult
summary: How to Share Disney Plus on Zoom : Start or join a meeting in Zoom, tap on Share to start casting and open Disney + app to stream a movie.
content:
Do you want to host a virtual movie night with your loved ones or friends, even if you are in different places? Thanks to Zoom, you can now stream Disney movies and create magical moments together. However, some users may wonder whether Disney Plus allows screen sharing and, if so, how to share it on Zoom. If you’re curious about the same thing, then keep on reading!

  • How to Share Disney Plus on Zoom
  • Can You Screen Share Disney Plus on Zoom?
  • Does Disney Plus Allow or Block Screen Sharing?

How to Share Disney Plus on Zoom

The screen-sharing feature of Zoom allows you to watch Disney movies together with your friends, no matter where they are located. If you’re unsure how to share Disney+ on Zoom, follow our simple step-by-step instructions below.

Can You Screen Share Disney Plus on Zoom?

Yes, you can! If you have a Disney Plus account, then you can stream movies and share Disney Plus on Zoom. Just click on the Share screen button during your Zoom meeting, and your screen will be shared with your friends and others.

Here’s a step-by-step guide on how to share Disney Plus on Zoom:

Note: Ensure that you have both a Disney Plus and a Zoom account.

1. Log into the Zoom app on your device and tap on New Meeting or Join an existing one.

2. Scroll through the options and select the Share option.

3. From the list of options, tap on Screen.

4. To start recording or casting, tap on START NOW from the prompt that appears.

5. Once screen sharing has started, open the Disney Plus app on your device.

6. Select any movie or TV show you want to watch together.

Now, you and your friends can enjoy Disney movies together, regardless of your physical location.

Also Read: How to Stream Disney Plus on Discord

Does Disney Plus Allow or Block Screen Sharing?

Yes, Disney Plus allows screen sharing on Zoom. There is no conclusive evidence to suggest that Disney Plus actively blocks screen sharing. Screen sharing generally works smoothly unless there are outdated apps or other technical issues.

Disney + even allows you to connect with up to seven other profiles simultaneously, making it perfect for connecting families. However, it’s essential to note that screen sharing may be restricted if your cable provider has not authorized Disney Plus streaming.

We hope this article has helped you in learning how to share Disney Plus on Zoom. If you have any queries or suggestions for us, then you must leave a comment in the box given below. Also, let us know what you want to learn next from us.

title: What Font Does Zoom Use?
subtitle: As the default font for their display elements and chats, Zoom uses the Google font Lato 801. Its logo however is designed using Kaleko 205.
author: Techcult
summary: As the default font for their display elements and chats, Zoom uses the Google font Lato 801. Its logo however is designed using Kaleko 205.
content:
Not only for its user-friendly yet feature-rich interface, Zoom has also been known for its sleek and professional appearance. One key aspect that contributes to its visual appeal is its choice of font. This often creates a curiosity among app developers and designers to learn about what font does Zoom use, its size, and how they can download them. Well, read this article to find out!

  • What Font Does Zoom Use?
  • How to Adjust Font on Zoom
  • Changing Chat Display Size on Zoom
  • Changing Font Text Size on Zoom

What Font Does Zoom Use?

Zoom uses Google font Lato 801 as the default font. It is the same font that can be seen on the main display as well as in the chat section. For its logo, Zoom uses the Kaleko 205 font. The platform allows the users to modify their styling to change the font. Such changes are integrated with your Zoom application but not with the Zoom client.

We understand that want to download the font Zoom uses. However, finding the exact font to download and use can be challenging. You can explore various free font apps and commercial libraries such as FFonts.net or wFont.com that offer fonts with a similar style to the one used in Zoom. 

Also Read: What Font Does WhatsApp Use?

How to Adjust Font on Zoom

Users prefer personalizing their font or chat display size, and Zoom lets them modify both. However, this feature is only available for the Zoom PC version and not the Android or iOS app. Let’s go through the process.

Changing Chat Display Size on Zoom

On Zoom, the default chat display size is set at 100%. However, you can increase or decrease it as you like. Follow the steps mentioned below:

1. Open Zoom on the PC and click the Settings icon at the top right corner.

2. Click Accessibility on the left pane, followed by Chat Display Size.

3. Select your preferred size for the chat window from the drop-down menu. 

Also Read: How to Change Font Style in WhatsApp

Changing Font Text Size on Zoom

Closed captions in Zoom provide subtitles for video conferencing and you can change their font size. Follow the step mentioned below:

1. Open Zoom, navigate to Settings, followed by Accessibility.

2. In the right pane, you will see a slider bar under Close Caption.

3. Drag the slider to increase the size of the font.

You can also modify the Caption color and Transition color as preferred.

Recommended: What Font Does Snapchat Use?

That’s all folks! We hope this article helped you learn what font does Zoom use. If you have any queries or suggestions for us, do let us know in the comments box below.

title: How to Fix Zoom Error 3003 on PC
subtitle: Zoom Error 3003 on PC is triggered when a participant tries to join a meeting using link created for co-hosts. Modify the link to fix it.
author: Techcult
summary: Zoom Error 3003 on PC is triggered when a participant tries to join a meeting using link created for co-hosts. Modify the link to fix it.
content:
Post Covid-19, Zoom has changed the dynamics of video conferencing, official meetings, informal hangouts, and virtual sessions. However, just like any other software, it also has its trials and tribulations. Occasionally, the platform throws a curveball 3003 our way. Now the question arises, what is Zoom Error Code 3003, and how to fix it on a PC? Let’s find out!

  • How to Fix Zoom Error 3003 on PC
  • Method 1: Reconstruct Link Format
  • Method 2: Ask Primary Host to Share Link
  • Method 3: Request Host to Start a New Meeting
  • Method 4: Verify Scheduling Privileges
  • Method 5: Run Windows Store App Troubleshooter
  • Method 6: Update Zoom
  • Method 7: Contact Support
  • Method 8: Reinstall App
  • Is it Possible to Run a Meeting Without a Host?

How to Fix Zoom Error 3003 on PC

Error 3003 on Zoom pops up when there’s confusion between hosts. It typically occurs when a participant tries to join a meeting using a link not from the meeting’s primary host. Okay, let us explain in detail.

Zoom allows multiple hosts for a session, one being the primary host who initiates the call while others are referred to as co-hosts. In a meeting, the primary host can assign participants to be co-hosts. Every time a co-host is added, a new link is created. Such links are supposed to be used only by co-hosts and not by the members. So, when other participants try to join the meeting using the link created for co-hosts, Error 3003 not meeting host appears on Zoom. It indicates that the participant is not recognized as the primary host.

Sometimes the error code 3003 also appears on Zoom while you schedule, edit, or cancel the meeting on behalf of someone who has assigned you the scheduling privileges.

Now that we know the primary cause behind the error, let’s see how to fix it!

Method 1: Reconstruct Link Format

As we already know, the modified link is the actual culprit here. So, let’s reconstruct the link and you can try to join the meeting using that. For example, usual Zoom meetings follow a general format as http://iu.Zoom.us/meeting/(meeting number). Now, all you need to do is copy the link, paste it on any text field, and then replace meeting with j. The new link should look something like this: http://iu.Zoom.us/j / (meeting number). Click on it and see if you can join the meeting.

Method 2: Ask Primary Host to Share Link

If modifying the link does not let you join the meeting, it’s better to ask the primary host to share the original link. Once they send the link, you can click on it and join the meeting.

Method 3: Request Host to Start a New Meeting

Now for some reason, if you are still not able to access the meeting, ask them to start a new meeting. While it might be a feasible option for everyone, if it is for you, go for it.

Also Read: How to Look Good on Zoom

Method 4: Verify Scheduling Privileges

Scheduling privileges on Zoom are limited to Licensed and On-Prem users. So, verify that both you and the user you are scheduling a meeting for are Licensed users with an active premium plan.

Secondly, if the Zoom schedule meeting error 3003 appears on the PC at the time of editing or canceling a meeting for another user, you can check if any form of modification has been done to the privileges settings.

Method 5: Run Windows Store App Troubleshooter

Minor glitches often hinder the features and functionality of an app. However, you can easily fix them using the built-in troubleshooter provided in Windows. Follow the steps mentioned below:

1. Open Settings on the Windows PC

2. Click on the System tab in the left pane and choose Troubleshoot from the right.

3. Click on Other troubleshooters.

4. Click on Run next to Program Compatibility Troubleshooter.

5. Select Zoom from the list of apps and click on Next.

6. Select Troubleshoot program and follow the on-screen instructions.

Windows will detect error 3003 in the Zoom app on the PC and fix it.

Also Read: How to Play Charades on Zoom

Method 6: Update Zoom

Outdated apps are prone to bugs and glitches that lead to such errors. Updating them usually resolves the issues. Follow the steps mentioned below:

1. Launch the Microsoft Store and select Library from the left sidebar.

2. Click on Get updates.

Method 7: Contact Support

If the error still persists, you can contact Zoom support to help. There are two ways to do so:

1. Raise your query and tag Zoom on Twitter.

2. Visit their official help page and inform them about the error, so they can help you fix it.

Also Read: How to Make Zoom Meeting Unlimited Time for Free

Method 8: Reinstall App

In the meanwhile, until you get a response from the Zoom support team or any update to fix the bug, you can try to reinstall the app. In some cases, it might get the issue resolved.

1. Launch Settings on the PC.

2. Click on Apps in the left sidebar and then select Installed apps.

3. Find Zoom from the list of apps, click on the three horizontal dots icon next to it, and select Uninstall.

4. Search for Zoom in Microsoft Store and click on Install.

Is it Possible to Run a Meeting Without a Host?

Yes, it is possible to run a meeting without a host. However, for this, when scheduling a meeting the host should configure specific settings such as:

  • Disable the Waiting Room feature.
  • Enable Allow participants to join anytime, i.e., before the host.

Moreover, the original host can start the meeting and designate the title to any other participant or add co-hosts to the meeting.

Recommended: How to Make Zoom Better Using its Best Apps

We hope this article helped you fix the Zoom Erro 3003 on a PC. If you have any queries or suggestions, do let us know in the comments box below. To find out solutions to any such tech-related issues, stay connected to TechCult.

title: How to Lower Volume Only on Zoom
subtitle: How to Lower Volume Only on Zoom: Go to the Volume mixer settings on your PC and decrease the volume for the Zoom app
author: Techcult
summary: How to Lower Volume Only on Zoom: Go to the Volume mixer settings on your PC and decrease the volume for the Zoom app
content:
Do you encounter problems with excessive background noise or participants speaking too loudly on Zoom? If so, we can help you eliminate distracting background noise! In this situation, you may want to adjust the volume on this app without affecting the computer’s volume. This comprehensive guide will guide you on how to lower only the volume on Zoom without lowering the computer volume.

  • How to Lower Volume Only on Zoom
  • How to Lower Zoom Volume Without Lowering Computer Volume?
  • Does Zoom Auto Adjust Volume?
  • How to Adjust Microphone Volume in Zoom?
  • Method 1: In Zoom Meeting
  • Method 2: Via Home Tab of the App
  • Method 3: Auto Adjust Volume
  • How to Adjust Volume in a Zoom Meeting?

How to Lower Volume Only on Zoom

You can easily lower the Zoom volume on a Windows PC without affecting the computer volume. The volume mixer feature on Windows devices allows you to achieve this. Here’s a simple step-by-step guide on how to do it:

1. On your Windows PC, click on the Speaker icon from the action menu on the taskbar at the bottom-right corner.

2. Click on the Sound box icon next to the volume slider.

3. Then, click on More volume settings.

Note: Alternatively, you can arrive here through Settings of your Windows PC.

4. Scroll down and click on Volume mixer under Advanced.

5. Left-drag the slider next to Zoom to lower the volume of the Zoom app. This way, the volume level of the overall computer is not altered.

Also Read: Fix Zoom Audio Not Working Windows 10

How to Lower Zoom Volume Without Lowering Computer Volume?

Read and follow the steps mentioned above to lower the Zoom app volume.

Does Zoom Auto Adjust Volume?

Yes. Zoom auto-adjusts microphone volume only if the setting is enabled. Otherwise, it runs on the volume level of the device.

How to Adjust Microphone Volume in Zoom?

The microphone volume controls the loudness of your voice when it is captured. If the volume is low, your microphone will mainly pick up faint background noises, so you’ll have to speak loudly.

To adjust the microphone volume in Zoom, follow the methods mentioned below.

Method 1: In Zoom Meeting

1. In an ongoing Zoom meeting, click on the upward arrow next to the microphone icon from the bottom-left corner, as shown below.

2. From the menu, click on Audio Settings…

3. Locate the Volume slider under the Microphone >Input Level section and adjust the slider to modify the input volume of your mic.

Also Read: How to Make Zoom Better Using its Best Apps

Method 2: Via Home Tab of the App

title: How to Play Charades on Zoom
subtitle: How to Play Charades on Zoom: Start a new meeting and invite all desired participants. Set the rules and create teams to start playing
author: Techcult
summary: How to Play Charades on Zoom: Start a new meeting and invite all desired participants. Set the rules and create teams to start playing
content:
Are you tired of attending monotonous work meetings on Zoom?

Then, you might consider playing virtual games like charades to liven up your virtual hangouts.

This tutorial will show you how to play dumb charades on Zoom and have a great time.

  • How to Play Charades on Zoom
  • What are the Charade Words?
  • What are the 4 Categories of Charades?
  • Tips to Play Charades Virtually on Zoom
  • What are the Alternate Ideas or Rules to Play Charades on Zoom?

How to Play Charades on Zoom

Charades is a popular word game that is generally played offline by a group of people.

The Zoom version of charades is playing the game with the same rules virtually on a call.

  • The game starts by dividing the meeting participants into two or more groups.
  • A person from a group acts out a movie, TV show, book name, city name, or other words, which their teammates need to guess.
  • The person enacting the word should not talk or move their lips. They are only allowed to make gestures with their hands and limbs.
  • After each correct guess, the team scores a point. The team with the maximum points at the end of the game wins.

However, there are no hard-coded steps or rules to play dumb charades on Zoom. But we bring you some guidelines to do the same.

1. Launch the Zoom app on your PC and click on New Meeting.

2. Click on Participants at the bottom of the application.

3. Click on Invite and invite the desired participants to the meeting.

4. Request everyone to give their camera access and keep their video feed on.

Note: Make sure you can see everyone in this Zoom meeting.

5. Split the participants into teams and ask each team to appoint someone to act for a word or phrase.

6. Let the appointed performer act out their gestures, and their teammates guess the word or phrase.

Note: Make sure that the performer’s Spotlight is on. So that everyone can clearly see their gestures and play charades on Zoom.

7. Set a timer for the teammates of the actor to make their guesses.

8. The participants from the guessing team must call their guesses and earn a point for a correct guess.

9. Keep track of the points earned by each group.

This cycle continues, and the team with the maximum number of points at the end wins.

It’s interesting to play charades on Zoom, isn’t it?

Also Read: How To Play Family Feud On Zoom

What are the Charade Words?

Charade words are words that people act out using gestures while their teammates try to guess them.

You can get creative and come up with your own charade words.

Here are some popular charade words that can inspire you.

  • Movie names (for example, The Shawshank Redemption, Dunkirk, and so on)
  • TV shows (for example, Breaking Bad, Better Call Saul, Friends, and so on)
  • Song names (for example, Lover, Animals, Night Changes, and so on)
  • Books (for example, Harry Potter)
  • Country or city names (Argentina, Tokyo, and so on)
  • Musical artist names (for example, Alan Walker, Taylor Swift, Martin Garrix, and so on)
  • Sportspersons or games (for example, Virat Kohli, Cristiano Ronaldo, and so on)
  • Animal charades words (for example, whale, lion, tiger, elephant, and so on)
  • Actor/Actress names (for example, Jennifer Aniston, Bob Odenkirk, and so on)

You can also generate charade words from sites like The Game Gal and Get Charades Ideas.

What are the 4 Categories of Charades?

The four categories of charades to play on Zoom are:

  • Traditional Charades: The most popular version, where players act out anything randomly, making it challenging.
  • Themed Charades: Players agree on a specific theme, like songs or movies, for their word choices.
  • Reverse Charades: A group acts out clues for a single person to guess the word.
  • Free for All Charades: A social and non-competitive version where everyone is on the same team, taking turns to act while others guess.

Also Read: 40 Interesting and Funny Question Games to Play with Friends on WhatsApp

Tips to Play Charades Virtually on Zoom

Here are some additional tips to enjoy the game to the fullest and make it a memorable experience:

  • Ensure a stable Internet connection
  • Set clear and concise instructions, including time limits, gestures, how to answer, and penalties for erring
  • Choose a theme that relates to your work and employees
  • Try using breakout rooms, if needed, for initial team discussion
  • Ensure time management using an in-game timekeeper or set a time limit using a timer on Zoom call
  • Make changes considering the feedback and suggestions, if needed
  • Schedule short breaks between rounds to avoid fatigue
  • Play music in the background to add energy and excitement
  • Encourage players to use household items as props to add creativity and humor
  • Encourage players to dress up according to the charade theme for extra fun
  • Award bonus points for creativity, challenging charades, or hilarious performances
  • Use Zoom virtual background feature to set the scene for your charades

What are the Alternate Ideas or Rules to Play Charades on Zoom?

Are you tired of playing the usual charades?

Then, you can try out these alternatives:

  • Only Sounds: The person has to make only sounds related to the word or phrase rather than acting. Others can still talk and guess it.
  • No Expressions: The actor can act out without showing any expression, and the person has to keep a neutral face.
  • Pictionary: The player has to draw the word or phrase, and the team members should guess it.
  • One-Word Wonders: The player has to give only one-word clues. For example, king for lion, dance for ballet.

Also Read: How to Play Jeopardy on Zoom

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q1. Is it possible to play charades virtually or online?

Ans. Yes, you can play charades virtually on several video conferencing platforms such as Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams.

Q2. What are some of the best charade ideas?

Ans. Some of the best charade ideas are:

  • Movie titles, lines, or iconic scenes
  • Song titles
  • Book titles, quotes, or characters
  • Celebrities or influential leaders
  • Different professions or job duties
  • Famous landmarks, cultural icons, or traditional dances around the world
  • Historical events, figures, or inventions

Q3. What are some of the best charade generators for adults?

Ans. Some of the best charade generators for adults are Random Word Generator, The Game Gal, Get Charades Ideas, Code Beautify, and TeamBuilding.

Q4. Is playing charades on Zoom hard?

Ans. No, if you have communicated the instructions clearly and have the ability to coordinate even bigger groups, then playing charades on Zoom is not hard.

We hope this guide has given you insights into how to play charades on Zoom.

Remember, you can unleash your creativity and establish your own rules with friends when playing the game.

Keep visiting our website for additional helpful tips and tricks!

title: How to Make Your TikTok Account Private
subtitle: How to Make Your TikTok Account Private: Open TikTok, Select Settings & privacy, Select Privacy, Turn the toggle on for Private account
author: Techcult
summary: How to Make Your TikTok Account Private: Open TikTok, Select Settings & privacy, Select Privacy, Turn the toggle on for Private account
content:
TikTok has established its way as one of the most used platforms for the century. If you have recently created an account or wish to change your privacy preferences, knowing how to make your TikTok account private is the first step to go. So, let’s get started!

  • How to Make Your TikTok Account Private
  • Method 1: Via Mobile
  • Method 2: Via Desktop

How to Make Your TikTok Account Private

Now you can be on the low and use your TikTok just how you want to.

Method 1: Via Mobile

With just a few taps, you can easily switch profiles from public to private:

  1. Open TikTok and tap on your profile from the bottom ribbon.
  2. Tap on the hamburger icon in the top right corner.
  3. Select Settings and privacy.
  4. Select Privacy under Account.
  5. Then, turn the toggle on for Private account.

Your account will become private for users.

Method 2: Via Desktop

Similarly, you can do the same from the web version of TikTok. Here’s how:

  1. Log in to TikTok and click on More from the left menu.
  2. Select Settings.
  3. Click on Privacy.
  4. Then, turn the toggle on for Private account under Discoverability.

That’s it, your account will go into private mode.

Now you will no longer have a difficult time figuring out how to make your TikTok account private after following this guide. For more helpful tips and tricks, stay tuned, and feel free to share your suggestions in the comments below.

content:

What does Oiled Up Mean on TikTok?

The Oiled Up trend shows people filming themselves, or others, drenched in oil, usually to show off muscles, dance moves, or just for fun vibes. It’s more than just literal; they’re often flaunting confidence, body shimmer, or product recommendations on TikTok. According to the Urban Dictionary, oiled up can also refer to getting drunk or tipsy. Being completely vanquished or beaten in a physical conflict is another way that the term oiled up can be used in slang. Therefore, depending on the context of the video, it can mean various things.

Is “Oiled Up” a Trend or a Look?

Yes, it’s both. Many creators use the oiled-up look for fitness, skincare, or glow-up videos.

Why Do People Get Oiled Up Before Filming?

Applying oil enhances muscle definition and gives the skin a glowing, polished effect on camera.

What Kind of Oil Do TikTokers Use for the Look?

title: TikTok Coins Explained: What Are They & How to Use
subtitle: TikTok Coins Explained: These are in-app currencies that allow users to support creators by sending gifts during live streams
author: Techcult
summary: TikTok Coins Explained: These are in-app currencies that allow users to support creators by sending gifts during live streams
content:
Over the years, TikTok has evolved past just viral dances and trends. It has not built its own economy through features like Coins, where creators and fans connect through virtual gifts. But how much are they worth, and how do they actually work? In today’s guide, we will explain to you exactly what TikTok coins are so that you can use them or redeem them for yourself. Let’s turn those digital cheers into real support!

  • What Are TikTok Coins?
  • How Much Are TikTok Coins Worth?
  • Creator Earnings Commission Percentage
  • Conversion Rate of Coins to Diamonds
  • What is the Value of Gifts in TikTok Coins?
  • How to Buy & Manage TikTok Coins?
  • Method 1: Via TikTok App
  • Method 2: Via TikTok Website
  • TikTok Coins v/s. Diamonds
  • How to Maximize TikTok Coin Earnings
  • Can I Refund TikTok Coins?
  • Can I Get My Gift Return on TikTok?
  • How to Resolve Coins Not Showing Up After Purchase

What Are TikTok Coins?

TikTok Coins are in-app currencies that allow users to support their favorite creators by sending gifts during live streams, turning likes into real earnings. Coins play a key role in TikTok’s creator monetization model. These in-app tokens let viewers purchase virtual gifts and support their favorite creators, directly boosting a creator’s earnings. Creators get Diamonds for each virtual gift they get. These Diamonds serve as a conversion metric for monetization, and TikTok sets their value. TikTok’s compensation scheme allows creators to cash out their Diamonds. However, before sending the funds to the creator’s PayPal account or bank account, TikTok charges a percentage as a service charge.

How Much Are TikTok Coins Worth?

Due to regional pricing and currency exchange rates, TikTok Coin prices vary by nation. Below are the costs of buying 70 and 700 coins in different nations.

  • 70 coins: $0.84 USD
  • 350 coins: $4.20 USD
  • 700 coins: $8.40 USD
  • 1,400 coins: $16.80 USD
  • 3,500 coins: $42.00 USD
  • 7,000 coins: $84.00 USD
  • 17,500 coins: $210.00 USD

Creator Earnings Commission Percentage

Typically, creators receive 50% of the coin’s value in Diamonds. Since the approximate worth of each diamond is 0.005 USD, therefore, five dollars would be equivalent to 1,000 diamonds.

Conversion Rate of Coins to Diamonds

When viewers give virtual gifts to creators during live streams on TikTok, the creators get Diamonds. One TikTok coin is often equivalent to half a diamond. For example, the maker would receive 50 diamonds if they received 100 coins as a gift. This indicates that diamonds are worth roughly half as much as coins.

What is the Value of Gifts in TikTok Coins?

Different gifts range in value, such as:

  • Rose: 1 coin for USD 0.01
  • Panda: 5 coins for USD 0.05
  • Fireworks: 999 coins for USD 10
  • Ferris Wheel: 3,000 coins for USD 30
  • TikTok Universe: 34,999 coins for USD350

How to Buy & Manage TikTok Coins?

If you’re looking to buy coins to send to a creator, you can purchase them in two ways.

Method 1: Via TikTok App

Follow the steps below to do the same:

  1. Open TikTok and tap on your profile.
  2. Tap the hamburger icon at the top right corner
  3. Select Settings and Privacy.
  4. Swipe down and tap on Balance to view your current Coins.
  5. Select the number of Coins you want to buy.
  6. Now, select Recharge.
  7. Enter the payment method from credit/debit card, PayPal, or other available methods.
  8. Complete the payment process.

You will now be able to use the coins on the platform.

Method 2: Via TikTok Website

Users often get a cheaper bundle of coins from the website. Visit the official website of TikTok Coin Purchase and follow the same steps as mentioned in Method 1: Via TikTok App.

TikTok Coins v/s. Diamonds

You’re not the only one if you have been confused between coins and diamonds. Let’s end this mystery:

  TikTok Coins
TikTok Diamonds
What They Are Virtual currency users buy to send gifts Virtual earnings creators receive from gifts
Who Uses Them Viewers and fans Creators or TikTokers
Purpose To purchase virtual gifts during live streams To track and convert gift earnings
How They’re Obtained Purchased with real money via TikTok app or website Earned when viewers send gifts bought with coins
Monetary Value 1 Coin ≈ $0.01 – $0.015 1 Diamond ≈ $0.005 (subject to TikTok’s policies)
Conversion Coins → Gifts Diamonds → USD (withdrawable via TikTok payout system)
Cash Out Option Cannot be cashed out, only used within TikTok ecosystem Can be withdrawn as real money
Platform Fee TikTok may charge slightly more for in-app purchases TikTok takes a significant cut before payout

How to Maximize TikTok Coin Earnings

As a creator, you can try out various ways through which your followers send you coins:

  • Be more engaging in live streams.
  • Use call-to-actions like “Drop Fireworks to congratulate me!”
  • Go live discussing popular subjects and trends.
  • Use trending hashtags and audio on your videos.
  • Collaborate with other popular creators during live streams.
  • Give top gifters extra recognition, Q&A sessions, or behind-the-scenes content.
  • Give live streams with only exclusive subscribers.
  • Organize challenges or competitions where gifters can follow or win exclusive interactions.

Can I Refund TikTok Coins?

Refunds for TikTok Coins are typically not given unless the coins are defective or mandated by law. According to TikTok’s Coin Policy, you have 14 days from the day after you buy the coins to cancel your order and ask for a refund.

Can I Get My Gift Return on TikTok?

No, once you have spent the coins as a gift, TikTok cannot refund the coins or the gifts.

How to Resolve Coins Not Showing Up After Purchase

If your coins are not reflecting in your profile after a purchase, you can try out these methods:

  • Wait for some time for the coins to be processed.
  • Log out and re-login to your account.
  • Contact TikTok Support.
  • Uninstall and reinstall TikTok.

Also Read: How to View Your Watch History in TikTok

Now that you have gone through all the specifics of TikTok Coins, we hope your doubts are cleared with the methods shown in this guide. Keep visiting TechCult to know the latest tech walkarounds. If you have any queries or suggestions, do reach out to us in the comment section.

title: How to View Your Watch History in TikTok
subtitle: How to View Your Watch History in TikTok: Select Settings and privacy, Tap on Activity center, Select Watch History.
author: Techcult
summary: How to View Your Watch History in TikTok: Select Settings and privacy, Tap on Activity center, Select Watch History.
content:
TikTok is globally used to scroll through a wide category of short videos ranging from memes to tutorials. With such a fast-paced platform, it can be difficult to remember what you’ve seen even some days ago. Did you ever find yourself attempting to show your friend a funny TikTok but failing to locate it? We’ve all been there. The good news is that you can view your watch history on TikTok and easily access any videos. How? Let’s show you the answer below!

  • How to View Your Watch History in TikTok
  • How to Delete Your Watch History in TikTok
  • How to Check TikTok Watch Time and History

How to View Your Watch History in TikTok

With just a few taps, you can now see any videos you have recently watched on TikTok and revisit any content. Keep reading until the end to see how it’s possible.

  1. Log in to TikTok and tap on your profile from the bottom right ribbon.
  2. Tap on the hamburger icon at the top right corner.
  3. Select Settings and privacy.
  4. Swipe down and tap on Activity center under Content & Display.
  5. Now, select Watch History.

This way you can go through any videos you have recently seen.

How to Delete Your Watch History in TikTok

Users also can protect their privacy and remove videos from their accounts. Here’s how you can do so:

  1. Follow steps 1-5 from the previous heading How to View Your Watch History in TikTok.
  2. Tap on Select at the top right corner.
  3. Tick on the videos of your choice.
  4. Then, tap on Delete.
  5. Select Delete from the confirmation prompt.

How to Check TikTok Watch Time and History

If you wish to see how much time you spend on TikTok scrolling through your phone, check out the steps:

  1. Follow steps 1-4 from the previous heading How to View Your Watch History in TikTok.
  2. Tap on See all screen time and data.
  3. Tap on This week to select the date of your choice.
  4. Tap on Time spent from the top bar to check the total amount of time in average.
  5. Then, tap on TikTok opened to view the number of times you tapped on the app in the given time.

That’s it, this way you can get all the information about your TikTok usage.

By following the methods shown in this guide, we hope that now you have understood how to view your watch history on TikTok. Do not hesitate to comment or make suggestions if you have any queries. Keep visiting TechCult to learn more tech-related walkarounds.

title: How to Find Songs by Singing on TikTok
subtitle: How to Find Songs by Singing on TikTok: ap on the microphone icon & select Sound Search, Start humming or singing, Tap on the microphone icon
author: Techcult
summary: How to Find Songs by Singing on TikTok: ap on the microphone icon & select Sound Search, Start humming or singing, Tap on the microphone icon
content:
Finding out the song stuck in your head has never been easier! In an app where songs change by the minute, TikTok has found a great way to make sure you never miss out on updating your playlist. This is possible through its new feature called Sound Search, which will show you not only sounds but also videos related to the song. Amazing, isn’t it? So, let’s see how to find songs by simply singing on TikTok so you never miss out on discovering new music!

  • How to Find Songs by Singing on TikTok
  • Why Can’t I Find the Sound Search Option on TikTok?
  • Can Sound Search Also Detect TikTok Specific Sounds?
  • How Accurate is the TikTok Sound Search Feature?
  • Is TikTok Sound Search Better than Shazam?
  • Does TikTok Sound Search Save the Sounds After Finding?

How to Find Songs by Singing on TikTok

Now even if you remember the tunes or a simple lyric, you can look them up online on TikTok. With just a few taps, you can easily search for songs by humming the tunes you remember. Keep reading until the end to find out how.

  1. Open TikTok and tap on the home icon at the bottom left corner.
  2. Tap on the search bar at the top ribbon.
  3. Tap on the microphone icon and select Sound Search.
  4. Start humming or singing the song of your choice.
  5. Tap on the microphone icon to stop.

TikTok will show you the results and videos made on the song.

Why Can’t I Find the Sound Search Option on TikTok?

Currently, Sound Search is available to some users in select regions and is not yet widely available to everyone since it is still in its experimental phase to receive feedback from people. Additionally, it also requires an iPhone or iPad running iOS 12 or later and the latest version of TikTok to get the feature.

Can Sound Search Also Detect TikTok Specific Sounds?

Yes, Sound Search can also detect popular TikTok sounds and memes along with normal songs on the internet.

How Accurate is the TikTok Sound Search Feature?

The Sound Search feature is known to be pretty accurate in its testing phase for popular songs and meme sounds. But the tool might be glitchy with less popular songs. It may recognize the song title but not show related videos if the song isn’t widely used on TikTok.

Is TikTok Sound Search Better than Shazam?

No, since the Is TikTok Sound Search is still in its developing phase, currently, it does not have a better recognition ability than Shazam.

Does TikTok Sound Search Save the Sounds After Finding?

No, Sound Search will not save any songs from its results on TikTok.

Now that you have figured out how to find songs by singing on TikTok, go ahead and create videos as soon as you find new tunes. Keep visiting TechCult to know the latest tech walkarounds. If you have any queries or suggestions, do reach out to us in the comment section.

title: How to Recover Deleted TikTok Messages on iPhone and Android
subtitle: Request for your data within the TikTok app on your iPhone or Android device and recover deleted messages from the file recieved via email.
author: Techcult
summary: Request for your data within the TikTok app on your iPhone or Android device and recover deleted messages from the file recieved via email.
content:
Have you ever lost an important TikTok message by accident and wished you could get it back? It can be very frustrating to lose talks whether they were with a friend or a business contact. But there are several methods you can try to recover deleted TikTok messages on both iPhone and Android devices.

  • How to Recover Deleted TikTok Messages on iPhone and Android
  • How to Recover Deleted TikTok Messages on Android
  • How to Recover Deleted TikTok Messages On iPhone

How to Recover Deleted TikTok Messages on iPhone and Android

  1. Open the TikTok app and tap on Profile at the bottom.
  2. Tap on the three-dot menu icon in the top-right corner.
  3. Tap on Settings & privacy and then on Accounts.
  4. Go to Download your data section.
  5. Tap on Request data.
  6. After the file is ready, you can download it in your preferred format.

TikTok will now start getting your info ready to be downloaded. You will get an email with a link to download your info once the process is done. 

Note: The process might take a few days, based on how much info you have in your account.

Once you’ve downloaded the file, you can look through it to find the messages you deleted.

Although you can’t be sure that this way will work, it’s worth a shot, especially if you just deleted the messages.

How to Recover Deleted TikTok Messages on Android

If the above way did not work for you and you’re using Android then you can try a third-party recovery tool to get back your deleted TikTok messages. The Dr.Fone toolkit is a common choice but you can also try iMyFone D-Back that we have suggested for iPhone users.

  1. Download and install the Dr.Fone toolkit on your PC.
  2. Launch the Dr.Fone app and click on the Data Recovery option.
  3. Follow the on-screen instructions to enable USB debugging on your device.
  4. Click on Recover Android Data.
  5. After your device is detected, select the data you want.
  6. Click on Start Scan.
  7. After the data is recovered, preview and select the one you want.
  8. Click on Recover at the bottom.

How to Recover Deleted TikTok Messages On iPhone

If you have an iPhone then iMyFone D-Back is one of the best third-party restore tools you can use.

  1. Download and install the iMyFone D-Back software on your computer.
  2. Connect your iPhone to your computer using a USB cable.
  3. Launch the app and select the iPhone Recovery option.
  4. Follow the on-screen instructions and put your device into recovery mode.
  5. Once your device is detected, select the data you want.
  6. Click on the Scan button.
  7. Select the messages you want to recover.
  8. Click on the Restore to device or Recover to computer button to save the selected messages.

Also Read: Why Did My TikTok Messages Disappear?

So this is how you can recover deleted TikTok messages on both iPhone and Android devices. If you have any queries or suggestions do let us know in the comments section below.
