title: How to Add Caption on Tiktok: Beginner’s Guide
subtitle: You can use the Text tool during recording; add captions after recording, or enable auto-generate feature to add closed captions on TikTok.
author: Techcult
summary: You can use the Text tool during recording; add captions after recording, or enable auto-generate feature to add closed captions on TikTok.
content:
Often it’s the caption that serves as the voice for your video and makes it more impactful. It complements your video and entertains, informs, and inspires your viewers.

While the possibilities are endless, do you want to learn how to add closed captions on TikTok? Don’t worry, our guide has got your back. 

Let’s take an advantage to showcase your creativity on the short-form video content platform.

  • How to Add Caption on Tiktok
  • Method 1: Use the Text Tool During Recording
  • Method 2: Add Captions After Recording
  • Method 3: Enable Auto-Captions
  • How to Add Captions on Tiktok After Posting
  • Why Can’t I Add captions on TikTok?
  • Why Do You Need Captions on TikTok?

How to Add Caption on Tiktok

Closed captions provide a written representation of the spoken words or audio content in a video. You can use different font styles and patterns for captions, which can further improve your content aesthetically. 

Watch your videos come to life on TikTok, follow the methods mentioned below:

Method 1: Use the Text Tool During Recording

You can manually add text to your video while recording. Here’s how:

1. Open TikTok and start recording a new video.

2. While recording, tap the Text button on the right side of the screen.

3. Type your desired caption in the text box. You can customize the text as per your choice.

4. Tap on Done when you’re satisfied with your caption.

Also Read: How to Generate Auto Caption on YouTube Shorts

Method 2: Add Captions After Recording

If you’ve already recorded the video, TikTok still lets you add captions during the editing process.

1. Record your video as usual and tap on Done after recording.

2. On the editing screen, tap Text on the right side of the screen, and customize your caption as per your choice.

Note: You can also add multiple captions by tapping Text again and repeating the process.

3. When you’ve added all captions, tap on Done at the top-right corner.

Method 3: Enable Auto-Captions

TikTok uses speech recognition technology to transcribe spoken words into text and auto-generate captions. Here’s how to use it:

1. Record your video as usual and then on the editing page, tap Captions in the tool bar on the right side of the screen.

TikTok will automatically generate captions based on the audio in your video.

2. Review the same and edit them if necessary, by tapping on the pencil icon.

3. Tap Save when you’re satisfied and then post it.

Also Read: How to Turn Off Captions on TikTok

How to Add Captions on Tiktok After Posting

Captions can be a great reason for the videos going viral. They give the video a sense of content and creativity that attracts more audience.

Initially, the option to add the caption after posting was unavailable on TikTok. But after the recent updates, you can do the same. Refer to our guide on How to Edit TikTok Caption After Posting.

Why Can’t I Add captions on TikTok?

Some reasons why you might be unable to add captions to your TikTok video are:

  • After recording your video, you’ll be taken to a preview screen before officially posting. Tap the Next button to access the editing window where you can add captions, music, effects, and other elements.
  • Occasional app glitches can happen. Restart the device and then the app to fix them.
  • Outdated versions might have bugs or missing features, including caption editing. Update the app and see if that helps.
  • Your video doesn’t have any audio (e.g., music or recorded sound), which is why the Add caption option might be hidden. 

Why Do You Need Captions on TikTok?

Here are some key reasons why captions are important on TikTok, explained simply:

  • Many users scroll through TikTok with the sound off. Captions grab their attention, explain the video, and make them more likely to watch and engage.
  • Captions translate the video’s content into text, which is accessible to people who are deaf, hard of hearing, or speak different languages.
  • Captions act like mini-descriptions, helping people find your video when they search for related terms. Think of them like keywords for TikTok’s search engine.
  • As captions can be funny, informative, or creative, they make the content more enjoyable.

Recommended: 150+ Perfect Golden Hour Captions

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q1: What types of TikTok captions are there?

Ans: TikTok captions can be short, descriptive, question-type, seasonal, and many more.

Q2: How do you move captions on TikTok?

Ans: Unfortunately, when you enable automatic captions, these will appear fixed on the screen. However, manually added captions can be dragged across the screen easily.

Q3: Can you edit or add hashtags on TikTok after posting?

Ans: Yes, with the new TikTok update, users can now edit their Hashtags on TikTok.

Q4: Do captions affect the TikTok algorithm and the visibility of my videos?

Ans: Yes, captions can have an impact on the TikTok algorithm and the visibility of your videos. 

‍Captions can grab attention, add humor, and even help your content go viral on TikTok and we hope our guide helped you easily add them to your videos.

If you have any queries or suggestions for us, do let us know in the comments section and stay tuned to TechCult for more informative guides.

title: How to See If Someone is Active on TikTok
subtitle: Go through their profile and see if there is a green dot next to their profile picture, that indicates that the person is active on TikTok.
author: Techcult
summary: Go through their profile and see if there is a green dot next to their profile picture, that indicates that the person is active on TikTok.
content:
Amidst browsing through entertaining short form content, are waiting for someone to be active and you can have a quick chat with them? Or do you want to avoid someone when they are online?

We understand the eagerness. So, in this guide, we will tell you how to see if someone is active on TikTok or what their status it. Let’s begin.

  • How to See If Someone Is Active On TikTok
  • What is Activity Status on TikTok?
  • How to Turn Your Activity Status On / Off On TikTok
  • How Does the Last Activity Status on TikTok Work?
  • How Accurate Is Activity Status Feature on Tiktok?
  • Why Is TikTok Activity Status Not Showing?

How to See If Someone Is Active On TikTok

You can only see if someone is active on TikTok if you and the other person’s active status is enabled and you both follow each other on TikTok.

In order to check this you can see their profile picture. If you see a green dot on their profile picture it means that the person is online. Occasionally, you can still see this green dot for some time even if your friend is not active. 

TikTok also shows the Last active status which displays a timestamp of when the person was active on the platform. However, it is only shown for 2 days, beyond which, there will be no activity status displayed.

What is Activity Status on TikTok?

Activity status on TikTok allows mutual followers to see each other’s online status on the platform. Both parties must have turned on this feature.

How to Turn Your Activity Status On / Off On TikTok

Follow the steps mentioned below to turn activity status on/off on TikTok:

1. Open TikTok on your device and tap on the profile button at the bottom right corner. 

2. Tap the (Menu) three lines icon on the top right corner, select Settings and privacy, and then tap on Privacy.

3. Turn on or off the toggle for Activity status as preferred.

Also Read: Fairy Comments for TikTok to Copy and Paste

How Does the Last Activity Status on TikTok Work?

TikTok activity status allows a person to see the activity status of others if they are mutual followers and have turned on their activity status.

How Accurate Is Activity Status Feature on Tiktok?

While the activity status feature on TikTok is fairly accurate as it varies by user, occasionally there may be a small delay in status updates. Some users have reported that the status is shown as active even after 15 minutes of logging out.  

Also Read: How to Find Out Who Made a Fake TikTok Account

Why Is TikTok Activity Status Not Showing?

Some users have faced a problem with the TikTok activity status not showing. There could be many reasons for it like:

  • Activity status is turned off
  • Person has been inactive for more than two days
  • App is not updated

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q1. Why Don’t I Have Access to the Active Status Option On TikTok?

Ans. You might not have access to the TikTok active status option because not everyone has access to it currently.

Q2. Who Do You Share Your Activity Status With?

Ans. You share your activity status with mutual followers i.e. those you follow and who follow you back. If both of you have turned it on, you can see when they are active.

Q3. Should You Enable Activity Status on TikTok?

Ans. Enabling activity status is a personal choice. If you want to see when a person is online, you can enable it. However, you can avoid it if you are privacy concerned.

We hope our guide helped you see if someone is active on TikTok.

Leave your suggestions and queries below in the comment section. Keep reading our articles for more information.

title: How to Find Out Who Made a Fake TikTok Account

summary: Check the content they post, their followers and people they follow, and whether they promote spam to find out if it is a fake TikTok account.
content:
TikTok has provided countless opportunities for creators to create, connect, and grow.

However, one challenge that the platform poses is the emergence of fake accounts.

It is highly important how to find out who made a fake TikTok account in order to safeguard yourself and innocent users from falling victim to fraud and scams.

But how? While it seems not so easy, especially because these accounts take multiple measures to protect their true identity, it isn’t impossible. We’ll help you with it.

  • How to Find Out Who Made a Fake TikTok Account
  • Method 1: Check Profile Content
  • Method 2: Check Whether It Promotes Spam
  • Method 3: Check Followers
  • Method 4: Check Other Social Media Handles
  • Method 5: Reverse Image Search
  • Method 6: Use TikTok Account Information Finder
  • How to Trace the Location of a Fake TikTok Account
  • Why It’s Important to Identify the Owner of a Fake TikTok Account?
  • How to Protect Yourself from Fake TikTok Accounts

How to Find Out Who Made a Fake TikTok Account

Here are some methods that can help you find out whether the person has made a fake account or not.

Method 1: Check Profile Content

Genuine account usually posts things that are related to their life, experience, skills, and more.

However, fake accounts tend to make random posts that are often stolen from other users. If you come across such posts, it’s a clear indication that the account is fake.

Method 2: Check Whether It Promotes Spam

Promoting spam on social media platforms is a common strategy used by fake accounts.

Usually, fake accounts generally spread various misleading information, such as job offers, discounts, fake links to gifts, or free subscriptions like Netflix and more. 

Also See: How to Find Out Who Made a Fake Facebook Account

Method 3: Check Followers

Fake accounts generally exhibit a distinct pattern of behavior. While these accounts follow a large number of people, they don’t have many followers themselves.

Moreover, mostly they follow business accounts so they can easily copy their videos, photos, or other personal information that users share. 

Method 4: Check Other Social Media Handles

Nowadays individuals maintain accounts on several social media platforms. If a user is real, it might be possible their username exists on other platforms too.

Enter the username on Instagram, Twitter Facebook, etc. to see if the user has accounts under the same name. If you don’t find any, it indicates a fake account.

Also Read: How Can You Find Out Who is Behind a Fake Snapchat Account

Method 5: Reverse Image Search

Reverse image search is an effective way to find out who created a fake TikTok account. 

Just save their profile picture and run a reverse image search. If the result displays the original person’s name that is not associated with the suspected account, it proves that the account is fake.

Method 6: Use TikTok Account Information Finder

TikTok user ID information is a helpful tool that provides various details about the user’s account such as who is the owner of the account, followers, what information it contains, etc.

1. Visit the Highsocial website and enter the username of the fake account in the search box.

2. Tap on the CHECK options.

3. Wait until the search result is generated.

Once the result is ready, you will be able to see the details about the TikTok account owner.

How to Trace the Location of a Fake TikTok Account

Grabify tool allows you to find and track the IP address of the fake TikTok account. Follow these given steps to track fake account locations.

1. Visit the Grabify IP logger website and in the Enter a URL or tracking code, field paste the TikTok account URL.

2. Tap on the Create URL option. A pop-up will appear, tap on the I Agree & Create URL.

3. Tap on the Copy button given next to the New URL option.

4. Navigate to your TikTok account and share the copied tracking link with the target user.

5. Once they tap on the URL, they will be redirected to the Grabify website.

6. Now, you can refresh the Grabify page and you will locate the IP address of the user.

Why It’s Important to Identify the Owner of a Fake TikTok Account?

Identifying the owner of a fake TikTok account is important for several reasons including:

  • To protect yourself and others from falling victim to scams.
  • Fake accounts can be created to spread false information. By identifying the owner, necessary actions can be taken such as reporting the account for deletion, suspension, or imposing penalties.
  • To prevent cyberbullying and harassment.

Also Read: How to Undo Not Interested on TikTok

How to Protect Yourself from Fake TikTok Accounts

Here are some helpful tips that help you protect yourself from fake TikTok accounts:

  • Be careful who you follow: Before you follow any account or accept a request, check if it is verified by TikTok or not. Also, take a look at their username, bio, and number of followers.
  • Enable privacy settings: If possible, set your account to private to ensure that only approved followers can view your content and access your personal information.
  • Avoid sharing any information: Avoid sharing your personal information such as your location, phone number, etc. in your bio.
  • Avoid clicking suspicious links: Be careful of any links shared by unknown TikTok accounts as they may lead to dangerous and harmful websites or malicious content.
  • Regularly check your list of followers: Stay updated on who follows you. If you find any account that tends to be fake or potentially harmful, immediately block or remove it from your account.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQS)

Q1. What to Do If You Find a Fake TikTok Account?

Ans. If you find a fake account on TikTok, block and report it. Also, share the account with your friends and followers and ask them to report as well as multiple reports are needed to delete the TikTok account. 

Q2. How Long Does It Take TikTok to Investigate a Fake Account

Ans. It is difficult to provide an exact timeframe for the investigation process on TikTok as the platform receives many reports daily, which can delay the process.

Q3. Can Fake TikTok Accounts be Permanently Deleted?

Ans. Yes, TikTok deletes fake accounts permanently if many users have reported it and once the investigation is completed.

Q4. Can a VPN Hide the Identity of a Fake Account Creator?

Ans. No, a VPN does not completely hide the identity of a fake account creator. However, it can disguise the user’s IP address and location.

We hope this article helped you find out who made a fake TikTok account.

If you have any queries or suggestions, please feel free to drop them in the comments section below. Don’t forget to visit TechCult for more helpful tips and tricks.

title: How to Undo Not Interested on TikTok
subtitle: How to Undo Not Interested on TikTok- Unfortunately, TikTok has not introduced feature to undo a not interested video on the platform yet.
author: Techcult
summary: How to Undo Not Interested on TikTok- Unfortunately, TikTok has not introduced feature to undo a not interested video on the platform yet.
content:
TikTok is a popular social media platform that allows users to create and share short videos. One feature of the app is the ability to indicate that you are not interested in a particular video by tapping on the “Not Interested” button. However, users may accidentally tap on this button or change their minds later. In this introduction, we will discuss how to undo “Not Interested” on TikTok.

  • How to Undo Not Interested on TikTok
  • Can I Undo “Not Interested” on TikTok?
  • How to Apply Not Interested on TikTok PC
  • How to Undo a Like on TikTok
  • What happens when you select Not Interested on TikTok?
  • TikTok New Features 2024

How to Undo Not Interested on TikTok

According to TikTok’s support page, there is no direct way to undo the “Not Interested” button once it has been tapped. However, there are a few workarounds that users can try to see the video again. One solution is to search for the video or the creator’s profile directly. This will allow users to find the video and watch it again, even if they have previously indicated that they are not interested. Another solution is to clear the TikTok cache, which may reset the “Not Interested” button and allow users to see the video again.

Can I Undo “Not Interested” on TikTok?

Unfortunately, there is no way you can undo not interested in TikTok.

However, you can try viewing, liking, and commenting on the same type of content for TikTok to learn your preferences. By doing this, you may make changes to your preferred content and make sure that your TikTok experience remains unique.

How to Apply Not Interested on TikTok PC

Follow the steps mentioned below to find the not interested button on TikTok PC:

1. Login to TikTok.

2. Click on the Report in the top right corner of the video.

3. Click on Other > I’m not interested.

4. Select Submit.

How to Undo a Like on TikTok

To Undo a like on TikTok simply single tap on the heart button (like button) and your like will be removed.

Also Read: Does TikTok Count Your Own Views?

What happens when you select Not Interested on TikTok?

By choosing the not interested option, you tell the app to stop showing that particular type of content on your feed. Gradually, said genre of content will become negligible or entirely disappear from your feed and suggestions.

The algorithm also reduces showing videos you have skipped and content from users you have hidden.

TikTok New Features 2024

TikTok has launched several features like:

  • TikTok has now launched a sleep reminder feature that provides an alert to go to sleep. You can set your sleep time to remind you daily.
  • A new thumbnail feature is introduced that lets you find a specific part of a video. You can easily skip to the part of the video you want to watch. 
  • Now you can check why a particular video is showing on your feed by going to your feed, clicking on the Share icon> Why this video.

Also Read: How to Fix 0 Views on TikTok

Even though there is no direct way to undo not interested option on TikTok, you can always like videos and let the algorithm give you similar videos. Keep reading our blog for more such information and leave your suggestions and queries in the comment section below.

title: How to Hide Reposts and Make Them Private on TikTok

author: Techcult
summary: TikTok doesn't offer a built-in option to make your reposts private but you can add those videos to your private collections.
content:
Many TikTok users love the Repost feature because it lets them easily share content they enjoy.

But if you want more control over who sees your videos, the platform’s options might feel limited.

In this guide, we’ll explain how you can make your reposts private on TikTok. So, keep reading till the end!

  • Can I Make My Reposts Private on TikTok?
  • Who Can See Your Reposts on TikTok Private Account?
  • What is the Easy Way to Hide Your Repost on TikTok?
  • How Can I Stop Someone from Reposting My TikTok Videos
  • How to See Someone’s Reposts on TikTok Without Following Them
  • Can Someone See Your Reposts on TikTok Without Following You?

Can I Make My Reposts Private on TikTok?

TikTok does not offer a specific private setting for reposts.

However, you can still manage who can see your reposted content by utilizing available options to control their visibility and achieve a similar effect.

Who Can See Your Reposts on TikTok Private Account?

When you repost on TikTok while having a private account, the visibility of your reposts will be restricted to your followers whom you have accepted.

This means that users who are not following you will not be able to see the content you repost, ensuring a level of privacy and control over who can view your activity on the platform.

What is the Easy Way to Hide Your Repost on TikTok?

TikTok doesn’t offer a direct feature to make your reposts private.

You can follow the below steps to add your favorite TikTok videos to collections:

1. Tap on the favorite icon on the video and tap on Manage.

2. Enter the collection name and turn off the toggle for Make public.

3. Tap on Save.

Also Read: Does TikTok Notify When You View Someone’s Profile?

How Can I Stop Someone from Reposting My TikTok Videos

While you can’t completely prevent someone from reposting your TikTok videos, there are several steps you can take to discourage it or limit its impact:

Method 1: Turn Off Duet and Stitch

Duet and Stitch features allow users to incorporate your video into their own creations.

Disabling them can minimize the chances of unwanted use:

1. Go to your TikTok Profile.

2. Tap on Settings and Privacy and then tap on Privacy.

3. Select Who can Duet with your videos.

4. Finally, set it to Only Me.

Method 2: Switch to a Private Account

A private account hides your reposts from everyone except confirmed friends on your account.

1. Go to the Privacy settings page.

2. Turn on the toggle for Private account.

Method 3: Include Polite Request

In the TikTok video caption or comments, kindly ask viewers to refrain from reposting without your permission.

This might not guarantee compliance, but it can raise awareness and prevent users from reposting.

Also Read: How Long Do Appeals Take on TikTok

Method 4: Report Inappropriate Reposts

If someone reposts your video in a way that violates TikTok Community Guidelines, such as harassment or spreading misinformation, you can report it for removal.

How to See Someone’s Reposts on TikTok Without Following Them

If you want to see someone’s reposts on TikTok without following them, you can only do so if their account is set to public.

Here are some tips to see someone’s reposts on TikTok without following them:

  • Check the Explore page on TikTok as it shows trending and reposted videos, including those from public accounts you may not follow.
  • Use TikTok search function to look for specific hashtags, sounds, or keywords related to the content you’re interested in. This may lead you to videos, including reposts, from users you don’t follow.
  • TikTok Discover feature highlights popular trends, challenges, and content creators. You may come across reposts from users you’re not following while exploring this section of the app.
  • Sometimes, comments or shares from other users may lead you to a TikTok user’s profile where you can find their reposts, even if you don’t follow them.

Remember, if a user’s account is set to private, you won’t be able to see their reposts unless they approve your follow request.

Can Someone See Your Reposts on TikTok Without Following You?

title: How to Fix Auto-Scroll TikTok Not Showing (Android and iOS)
subtitle: If auto scroll is not showing TikTok, make sure to activate the feature first and then clear out the cache files and data to fix the issue.
author: Techcult
summary: If auto scroll is not showing TikTok, make sure to activate the feature first and then clear out the cache files and data to fix the issue.
content:
Users were thrilled when TikTok introduced the auto-scroll feature, making it incredibly simple to binge-watch without having to manually scroll.

However, some TikTokers have complained that they are stuck on one post instead of smoothly moving to the next video on their For You feed.

No worries though! We’ve got your back explaining the reasons behind it and fixes for auto scroll TikTok not showing on both iOS and Android apps.

  • Why is Auto-Scroll Missing in TikTok and How to Fix
  • Method 1: Activate Auto-Scroll
  • Method 2: Clear Cache and Data
  • Method 3: Update TikTok
  • Method 4: Create a New TikTok Account
  • Method 5: Report the Problem

Why is Auto-Scroll Missing in TikTok and How to Fix

A significant number of users have reported that the auto-scroll feature does not function properly.

Some of the reasons are corrupt app cache, technical glitches, outdated app version, or your account restricted by TikTok.

Quick Answer

The easiest way to resolve this issue is a simple app and device restart. Additionally, try logging out and logging back in to get rid of minor app glitches and get back the auto-scroll feature.

Method 1: Activate Auto-Scroll

If your TikTok photos are not scrolling automatically, make sure that you’ve enabled the feature. Check our guide on How to Auto Scroll on TikTok and enjoy watching content without any effort.

Tip: Turn on the toggle for Faster scroll speed under Accessibility settings.

Method 2: Clear Cache and Data

Often temporary files stored by the app can become corrupt and cause issues with it. Hence, we suggest you clear out its cache data to see if that helps.

Option 1: Clear TikTok Cache on Android

1. Open Settings, tap on Apps, and then on Apps management.

2. Select TikTok and tap on Storage. Tap on Clear cache.

Also Read: How to Fix 0 Views on TikTok

Option 2: Clear TikTok Cache on iOS

1. Open TikTok and tap on the hamburger icon at the top.

2. Select Settings and Privacy from the menu.

3. Now, under the Cache & Cellular section, tap on Free up space, and finally, tap on Clear to get rid of the cache.

Method 3: Update TikTok

Possibly the app you’re using might be outdated and thereby prone to bugs and glitches. You can easily update TikTok on the Google Play Store or App Store to resolve the auto-scroll problem.

Method 4: Create a New TikTok Account

Your account may be restricted from performing certain activities. Although TikTok does not restrict accounts from auto-scrolling, just in case, you can make another account and check if it lets you use the auto-scroll feature.

Method 5: Report the Problem

Use the TikTok app to report your issue through the Report a Problem feature.

1. Open TikTok and tap your profile icon, followed by Settings and privacy.

2. Tap on Report a problem and describe the auto-scrolling issue.

Wait and the TikTok support team will identify the issue and provide solutions to resolve it.

Also Read: How to Undo Not Interested Videos on TikTok

If none of the methods help, reinstall the TikTok app to fix the auto scroll not showing issue.

Let us know your queries or suggestions in the comments and stay connected to TechCult for more such app-related guides.

title: How to Deactivate or Delete Telegram Account
subtitle: How to Deactivate or Delete Telegram Account: Visit Telegram Deactivation page, Enter number, Type in code, Select reason & Delete My Account
author: Techcult
summary: How to Deactivate or Delete Telegram Account: Visit Telegram Deactivation page, Enter number, Type in code, Select reason & Delete My Account
content:
Telegram has been the go-to messaging app for secure chats, media sharing, and community groups. But sometimes, you might decide to step away to cut down on screen time or switch platforms. In such cases, knowing how to deactivate or delete your Telegram account ensures you can leave without loose ends. So, let’s walk through how you can manage your account so that you know the right steps to avoid data loss!

  • How to Deactivate or Delete Telegram Account
  • Method 1: Via Manually Deactivating
  • Method 2: Via Self-Destruct feature

How to Deactivate or Delete Telegram Account

Now you can make a clean break from Telegram without leaving traces.

Method 1: Via Manually Deactivating

You can delete your account at any time manually.

Option 1: From Desktop

Check out the steps to do the same from your desktop:

  1. Visit the official Telegram Deactivation page.
  2. Enter your phone number in the box under Delete Account or Manage Apps.
  3. Select Next.
  4. Type in the confirmation code and select Sign in.
  5. Type in your number under Your Phone Number.
  6. Enter your reason under the Why are you leaving? box.
  7. Now, click on Delete My Account.

Your Telegram account will be successfully deactivated.

Option 2: From Phone

Similarly, follow the steps to do the same from the Telegram app.

  1. Open Telegram and tap on Settings from the bottom ribbon.
  2. Swipe down and select Privacy and Security.
  3. Swipe down and tap on If Away from under AUTOMATICALLY DELETE MY ACCOUNT.
  4. Then, tap on Delete Account Now.
  5. Select Delete My Account.

The Telegram account will be successfully deleted.

Method 2: Via Self-Destruct feature

Telegram also has a self-destruct feature that deactivates your account if not used within that time.

Option 1: From Desktop

Here’s how you can use this feature in the web version of Telegram:

  1. Log in to Telegram and click on the hamburger icon in the top left corner.
  2. Select Settings.
  3. Click on Privacy and Security.
  4. Click on If Away from under Delete my account.
  5. Now, select the option of your choice and click on SAVE.

Your account will be removed from the platform after this time.

Option 2: From Phone

Lastly, you can use the same feature on your phone:

  1. Open Telegram > Settings > Privacy and Security.
  2. Swipe down and tap on If Away from under AUTOMATICALLY DELETE MY ACCOUNT.
  3. Then, tap on the option of your choice.

That’s it, the account will not be active after the selected time.

Also Read: 10+ Best AI Tools for Telegram to Save time

Now you will no longer have a difficult time figuring out how to deactivate or delete your Telegram account after following this guide. For more helpful tips and tricks, stay tuned, and feel free to share your suggestions in the comments below.

title: 10+ Best AI Tools for Telegram to Save time
subtitle: Best AI Tools for Telegram to Save Time: IFTTT Bot, Dr.Web Bot, The Feed Reader Bot, Eddy Travels Bot, GetMedia Bot, and Botfather
author: Techcult
summary: Best AI Tools for Telegram to Save Time: IFTTT Bot, Dr.Web Bot, The Feed Reader Bot, Eddy Travels Bot, GetMedia Bot, and Botfather
content:
Telegram has become one of the most popular messaging platforms in recent years. Its interface is not only meant to text users but also hosts communities and groups around the world. To make browsing across the app easier, there are various best tools for Telegram available to use. If you’re having a hard time finding them, then you’re at the right place! Let’s dive in together.

  • Best AI Tools for Telegram
  • 1. IFTTT Bot
  • 2. The Feed Reader Bot
  • 3. Dr.Web Bot
  • 4. Eddy Travels Bot
  • 5. GetMedia Bot
  • 6. Spotify Downloader Bot
  • 7. Botfather
  • 8. Botpress
  • 9. Zoom Bot
  • 10. SkyStudio
  • 11. AppFollow Bot

Best AI Tools for Telegram

Now save your time and energy by utilizing some great options to enhance your Telegram experience.

1. IFTTT Bot

IFTTT (If This, Then That) is one of the smartest Telegram bots out there if you’re into automation. It connects your Telegram account with tons of other platforms, letting you create custom workflows called Applets. For example, you can set a Telegram command to trigger an action on Google Drive, Slack, or even smart home devices. The possibilities are pretty much endless, whether you’re automating reminders, saving files, or sending alerts. It’s free to start, with a premium plan beginning at $2.99/month.

2. The Feed Reader Bot

For content lovers who don’t want to miss a single update, Feed Reader Bot is a must-have. It lets you follow RSS feeds directly in Telegram by pasting the feed link into chat. Once subscribed, the bot sends updates as soon as new articles or videos are published. It’s like turning your Telegram into a personalized content dashboard. Super handy for bloggers, news junkies, or anyone tracking multiple sources at once, one of the best AI tools for Telegram..

3. Dr.Web Bot

Dr.Web is your personal digital bodyguard inside Telegram. It lets you quickly scan suspicious links or files by simply dropping them into the chat, and the bot runs a full check for malware or viruses. In seconds, you’ll get a safety report so you know if it’s okay to proceed. This is especially useful if you frequently receive files from unknown sources. It’s a lightweight but powerful cybersecurity tool, and it’s completely free!

4. Eddy Travels Bot

Planning your next getaway? Eddy Travels is a Telegram bot that helps you find great deals on flights, hotels, and more—all through a simple chat. Just type your destination or travel idea, and the bot does the searching for you in real time. It’s like having your own AI travel planner, available 24/7 without the need for browsing endless websites. Whether you’re backpacking or booking business trips, it keeps things fast and convenient, and is one of the best AI tools for Telegram.

5. GetMedia Bot

Need to grab a video from the internet quickly? GetMedia Bot helps you download videos by just pasting a link into the chat. It often gives you a few formats or quality options too, depending on the platform. It doesn’t always work perfectly with every site, but when it does, it’s a real time-saver. Whether you’re saving a clip for later or archiving content, it gets the job done with minimal effort.

6. Spotify Downloader Bot

This Telegram bot helps you download songs, albums, or entire playlists from Spotify as MP3s—right from your chat window. Just drop in a Spotify link, and it pulls high-quality audio with album art and proper metadata. You get the file in seconds, ready for offline use without needing the actual Spotify app. It’s super convenient and works especially well for playlists. Occasionally, it might miss a track or slow down during peak hours, but overall, it’s a handy tool.

7. Botfather

Botfather is the go-to Telegram bot for anyone who wants to create and manage their own bots. It acts like a control center where you can set names, add icons, generate tokens, and customize commands or privacy settings. Whether you’re building something simple or prepping a full-featured assistant, this is where your bot journey begins. It talks to you just like a regular bot, but it gives you developer-level control. If you’re serious about Telegram bots, this is your must-use starting point.

8. Botpress

Think of Botpress as your custom AI agent builder without the headache of learning deep code. It gives you a clean, easy-to-use platform where you can design smart bots for your website, app, or even customer support. One of its best features is the ability to bring your own language model (LLM), so you’re not locked into one AI brain. Whether you’re building something like ChatGPT for your team or creating workflow bots, Botpress makes it feel accessible. It’s great for businesses that want powerful bots with flexibility and one of the best AI tools for Telegram.

9. Zoom Bot

Zoom Bot brings a lightweight Zoom control panel right into your Telegram chat. You can schedule, start, or join meetings directly without opening the Zoom app. While it doesn’t replace Zoom itself or let you take calls inside Telegram, it’s perfect for those who plan meetings via chat. It saves time and avoids tab-hopping during work hours. Great for remote teams who want simpler meeting coordination.

10. SkyStudio

Sky is a smart reminder bot on Telegram that works like your digital assistant. You can set reminders in plain language—like “call John at 5” or “pay rent on the 1st of every month.” Once set, the bot sends you a message when it’s time to act. It’s great for both one-time tasks and recurring ones, helping you stay on track without needing extra apps. If you often forget things, Sky is a simple yet super helpful solution.

11. AppFollow Bot


AppFollow is a Telegram bot that helps you discover top-rated apps without scrolling endlessly through the app store. You can search for apps by keyword, see trending results, and even get suggestions for what to download next. It’s perfect when you want quality apps without the guesswork. The bot also shows you full app details, so you know exactly what you’re getting. Ideal for app hunters who want quick, reliable recommendations.

Also Read: How to Hide a Chat in Telegram Without Deleting

You must have found some of the best AI tools for Telegram. Keep catching up with TechCult for more such new tech-related walkarounds. If you have any suggestions or queries, do reach out to us in the comments section.

title: How to Hide Your Phone Number in Telegram
subtitle: How to Hide Your Phone Number in Telegram: Tap on Settings, Tap on Privacy and Security, Select Phone Number, Tick on Nobody.
author: Techcult
summary: How to Hide Your Phone Number in Telegram: Tap on Settings, Tap on Privacy and Security, Select Phone Number, Tick on Nobody.
content:
With millions of users worldwide, Telegram gained a reputation as a safe messaging platform known for its security features. Even while the platform is end-to-end encrypted, it has several other features and security settings that further strengthen users’ privacy. One of them is concealing your private information, such as a phone number. Knowing how to hide your phone number in Telegram can help you keep strangers from accessing your personal data. So, if you’re wondering the same, you’re in the right place. Let’s get started!

  • How to Hide Your Phone Number in Telegram
  • Method 1: Via Mobile
  • Method 2: Via Desktop
  • How to Customize Who Can See My Phone Number in Telegram
  • How to Change Who Can Find My Phone Number in Telegram

How to Hide Your Phone Number in Telegram

Whether you wish to avoid any online harassment or do not want your number to be easily accessible, hiding them can be a lifesaver. Stay tuned until the end to find out your answer.

Method 1: Via Mobile

Here’s how you can easily make sure that no one can see your number from the Telegram app on your smartphone:

  1. Open Telegram and tap on Settings from the bottom right ribbon.
  2. Swipe down and tap on Privacy and Security.
  3. Tap on Phone Number.
  4. Now, tick on Nobody.

With these easy steps, your number will be hidden.

Method 2: Via Desktop

Similarly, follow the steps mentioned below to do the same from the browser or web app of Telegram:

  1. Log in to Telegram Web and click on the hamburger icon at the top left corner.
  2. Scroll down and click on Privacy and Security.
  3. Click on Phone Number.
  4. Now, select Nobody.

That’s it, your number will successfully hide from view.

How to Customize Who Can See My Phone Number in Telegram

You can also modify your settings and add users to see or not see your number. Here’s how:

  1. Open Telegram and tap on Settings > Privacy and Security.
  2. Select Phone Number.
  3. Tick on My Contacts.
  4. Tap on Never Share With under EXCEPTIONS.
  5. Tick on the users of your choice and select Done.
  6. Then, tap on Always Share With.
  7. Tick on the users of your choice and select Done.

This way you can change who can see your number on Telegram.

How to Change Who Can Find My Phone Number in Telegram

Telegram also gives users the ability to change how someone can find them on the platform. This is how you can alter the settings:

  1. Follow steps 1-4 from the previous heading How to Hide Your Phone Number in Telegram, Method 2: Via Desktop. Please note that this option is only available in browser or web versions.
  2. Scroll down and select Everybody to let all users find you using your number.
  3. Select My Contacts to only let the users from your contact book find you through your number.

Now you can make your phone number more secure on Telegram.

Also Read: How to Send Spoiler Messages on Telegram

By following the methods shown in this guide, we hope that now you have understood how to hide your phone number in Telegram. Do not hesitate to drop a comment or suggestions in case you have any queries. Keep visiting TechCult to learn more tech-related walkarounds.

title: How to Use Telegram Without a Phone Number
subtitle: How to Use Telegram Without a Phone Number: Visit a virtual number platform, Select a number, Select Copy, Open Telegram, Paste copied number
author: Techcult
summary: How to Use Telegram Without a Phone Number: Visit a virtual number platform, Select a number, Select Copy, Open Telegram, Paste copied number
content:
Are you sick of letting yet another app use your phone number to sign in and view posts? Almost all platforms require your number to register an account but that is not the case with Telegram. If you intend to protect your privacy and keep personal information to yourself then knowing how to use Telegram without a phone number is a handy skill. This way you can take full advantage of its features without any limitations! Let’s jump right in.

  • How to Use Telegram Without a Phone Number
  • Method 1: Using Temporary Disposable Number
  • Method 2: Using Fragment Number
  • Method 3: Link Telegram to Another Device
  • Can I Use Telegram with a Landline Number?

How to Use Telegram Without a Phone Number

Bid farewell to the unnecessary requirement for a phone verification procedure if you don’t have one on Telegram. Stay tuned until the end to find out your answer.

Method 1: Using Temporary Disposable Number

The easiest way to use Telegram without the hassle of giving your number is through virtual phone numbers available on the internet. Here’s how:

Note: We do not endorse the use of third-party apps as they may expose your device to unwanted malware or viruses. User discretion is advised!  

  1. Visit the official site of any virtual number platform. Here we have taken Receive SMS Online.
  2. Swipe down and tap on Open under any phone number or country of your choice.
  3. Click on the number and select Copy.
  4. Now, install Telegram on your phone.
  5. Tap on Start Messaging.
  6. Paste the copied phone number.
  7. Tap on the arrow icon.
  8. Go to your browser and tap on Update Messages under the phone number.
  9. Copy the OTP shown under the number and paste it to Telegram.

With these easy steps, you no longer need to give your number to create a Telegram account.

Method 2: Using Fragment Number

Using a fragment number is another way to sign up for a Telegram account. These are blockchain-based, anonymous phone numbers that you can purchase to use with Telegram. Check out the steps to do the same:

  1. Install the Tonkeeper app from the Google Play Store or App Store.
  2. Type in your credentials and create a TON wallet account.
  3. Then, tap on Browser from the bottom ribbon.
  4. Swipe down and tap on Fragment under NFT.
  5. Tap on Connect TON from the top right corner.
  6. Now, scan a QR code from your phone.
  7. Tap on Numbers from the top ribbon.
  8. Select the number from your choice under Anonymous number and buy it.
  9. Open Telegram and tap on Start Messaging.
  10. Add your number and open Tonkeeper to get the OTP.
  11. Paste the OTP and tap on the arrow icon.

Now your account will successfully be created.

Method 3: Link Telegram to Another Device

Lastly, if you are logging in to Telegram from a desktop app and already have an account, you do not need a phone number to sign in. This is how you do so:

  1. Open Telegram in the browser or web version.
  2. Then, open the Telegram app on your smartphone.
  3. Tap on Settings from the bottom right ribbon.
  4. Swipe down and tap on Devices.
  5. Then, tap on Link Desktop Device.
  6. Aim the phone’s camera towards the QR code on your PC’s screen.

That’s it, you will now be signed in to another device without a number.

Can I Use Telegram with a Landline Number?

Yes, you can use a landline number to sign up for Telegram. During the verification process, choose the Call me option to receive a voice call with the verification code.

We hope that now you can easily learn how to use Telegram without a phone number by following the methods outlined in this guide. Do not hesitate to reach out to us in the comment section. Keep visiting TechCult for more tech-related know-how.

title: How to Download All Files from Telegram Group or Channel
subtitle: How to Download All Files from Telegram Group or Channel: Click on three dots of contact, Select Export chat history, Tick a file, Select Export.
author: Techcult
summary: How to Download All Files from Telegram Group or Channel: Click on three dots of contact, Select Export chat history, Tick a file, Select Export.
content:
Telegram has become one of the most popular communication platforms around the world. It is mostly used by small companies to promote their product line or people to share huge files such as movies or anime. If you have joined a channel or group and wish to know how you can download all files from Telegram, you’re at the right place. Let’s see how it’s done!

  • How to Download All Files from Telegram Group or Channel
  • Method 1: Via Chat Export Settings
  • Method 2: Via Selecting Files
  • What Types of Files Can Be Downloaded from Telegram Groups or Channels?
  • Are There Any File Size Limitations When Downloading Files from Telegram?

How to Download All Files from Telegram Group or Channel

Telegram easily allows its users to download your chat history in case you’d like to preserve it offline or share it with others. Stay tuned to find out how.

Method 1: Via Chat Export Settings

Follow the steps mentioned below to get every file exchanged in a Telegram channel at once:

  1. Open the Telegram web and click on the group or channel of your choice from the left panel.
  2. Click on the three dots at the top right corner of the group or channel.
  3. Select Export chat history.
  4. Tick on all file types you wish to download under Chat export settings.
  5. Drag the slider to the right to change the file size limit you wish to download.
  6. Click on Export.
  7. Click on Show my data once the download is completed.
  8. Go to your desktop’s download section to open and view the file.

This way all your downloaded files will get saved on your device.

Method 2: Via Selecting Files

You can also select specific files directly from the chat and download them from Telegram groups and channels. Here’s how:

  1. Open Telegram and click on your channel or group.
  2. Click on the channel profile.
  3. Scroll down and click on Files.
  4. Hover over the file and click on the download icon.

Now you can download as many files as you wish on Telegram.

What Types of Files Can Be Downloaded from Telegram Groups or Channels?

You can download any type of file shared in the Telegram channels such as documents, images, videos, audio files, and other multimedia.

Are There Any File Size Limitations When Downloading Files from Telegram?

Telegram allows the sharing and downloading of files up to 2GB in size per file. Larger files may require alternative solutions or multiple downloads.

title: How to Use Copilot on Telegram
subtitle: How to Use Copilot on Telegram: Open the Telegram app and Tap on Chats, Search Copilot and select bot, Tap on Start, Tap on I Accept
author: Techcult
summary: How to Use Copilot on Telegram: Open the Telegram app and Tap on Chats, Search Copilot and select bot, Tap on Start, Tap on I Accept
content:
AI integration has also made its way to Telegram to make our lives easier! The popular chatbot launched by Microsoft, Copilot, is now also available in Telegram. Now you can ask detailed questions, know the weather, and get movie recommendations from one app. So, if you’re wondering how to use Copilot on Telegram, this is the right place to be! Stay tuned until the end.

  • How to Use Copilot on Telegram
  • Option 1: Via Phone
  • Option 2: Via Desktop
  • Is Copilot for Telegram Free to Use? 
  • Is Copilot for Telegram Available on Windows, macOS, Android, or iOS?
  • What Can Copilot on Telegram do?

How to Use Copilot on Telegram

Copilot can be your new personal assistant which can help you from booking appointments to giving fashion advice. Now you can do it all!

Option 1: Via Phone

Here’s how you can get Copilot on your phone in Telegram.

  1. Open the Telegram app and tap on Chats from the bottom ribbon.
  2. Type in Copilot in the search bar and select the bot.
  3. Tap on Start.
  4. Then, tap on I Accept.
  5. Now, type in your messages such as asking for movie recommendations or song names.

Option 2: Via Desktop

Copilot is also available on the Telegram web version. Follow the steps mentioned below to get it on your PC:

  1. Open Telegram on your desktop and click on the search bar from the left menu.
  2. Type in Copilot and hit Enter.
  3. Click on Start.
  4. Now, click on I Accept.
  5. Type in your messages and hit Enter to receive answers.

Is Copilot for Telegram Free to Use? 

Yes, currently all Telegram users can add and use Copilot for free.

Is Copilot for Telegram Available on Windows, macOS, Android, or iOS?

Yes, Copilot for Telegram is available to use in all operating systems. Therefore, you can install the app on Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS and access the chatbox. Additionally, you can also use it online from Telegram web on your browser.

What Can Copilot on Telegram do?

Copilot Beta for Telegram only allows text chat requests. It can perform various tasks for users ranging from:

  • Information Search: Ask Copilot for in-depth responses to brief questions or thorough research using Bing Search.
  • Arranging a Trip: Copilot can assist users with route planning as well as destination suggestions for a getaway.
  • Fitness Advice: Copilot can offer workout regimens and fitness advice ranging from exercising to food intake.
  • Updates on entertainment: It will provide you with recommendations and up-to-date entertainment news on pop culture.
  • Leisure & Laughs: The chatbox can also entertain you with a joke, a humorous gif, or a recommendation for a light game.

Also Read: How to Download, Set up and Use Copilot App on iPhone

Now that you have understood how to use Copilot on Telegram, go ahead and make the app engaging and interactive. If you have any queries or suggestions, do reach out to us in the comment section. Keep visiting TechCult to know the latest tech walkarounds.

title: How to Send Spoiler Messages on Telegram
subtitle: Open the Telegram app, go to Chats, choose a contact, type in your message and long press on it, tap on Format, select Spoiler, and send it.
author: Techcult
summary: Open the Telegram app, go to Chats, choose a contact, type in your message and long press on it, tap on Format, select Spoiler, and send it.
content:
Telegram is one of the most widely used chat programs available, despite being relatively new. This is hardly surprising given that the app has a ton of useful and entertaining features. It is pretty difficult to avoid spoilers of your favorite shows online. Even though you steer away from reading reviews, how will you stop seeing messages in your chat group accidentally? Telegram has your back by offering a feature to send spoiler messages. Let’s see how you can use it!

  • How to Send Spoiler Messages on Telegram
  • Option 1: Via Phone
  • Option 2: Via Desktop
  • Can I Hide Images with a Spoiler Tag on Telegram?
  • Option 1: Via Phone
  • Option 2: Via Desktop
  • How is a Spoiler Message Shown on Telegram?
  • How do I View a Spoiler Message on Telegram?
  • Is a Hidden Message and Spoiler Message the Same on Telegram?

How to Send Spoiler Messages on Telegram

Now make sure your friends are protected from the latest gossip on a show, film, or game by adding a spoiler tag on your messages in Telegram. Keep reading to find your answer.

Option 1: Via Phone

Follow the steps to add a spoiler alert over your texts from the Telegram app on your phone.

  1. Open the Telegram app and tap on Chats from the bottom ribbon.
  2. Select a contact or group of your choice.
  3. Type in and long-press your message.
  4. Tap on Format and select Spoiler.
  5. Tap on the arrow icon to send your spoiler message.

Option 2: Via Desktop

You can also send spoiler texts from Telegram on the desktop version. Here’s how:

  1. Open Telegram and click on your targeted contact or group.
  2. Type in your text in the message field.
  3. Press and drag the words you wish to add a spoiler on and right-click.
  4. Click on the Blur icon from the list of formatting options and hit Enter.

Can I Hide Images with a Spoiler Tag on Telegram?

Yes, you can also use spoilers over images on Telegram. Here’s how:

Option 1: Via Phone

Keep following the steps outlined below to use spoilers on an image in Telegram:

  1. Open Telegram and then on Chats.
  2. Select the user or group and select the Attachment icon in the message field.
  3. Tap on the hollow circle on the image you wish to select.
  4. Then, tap on the three dots at the top right corner.
  5. Select Hide With Spoiler and tap on Send.

Option 2: Via Desktop

You can also do the same on the Telegram web version from your PC. Here’s how:

  1. Open Telegram and click on the user or group.
  2. Click on the Attachment icon.
  3. Select Photo or Video.
  4. Select your photo and click on Open.
  5. Click on the three dots in the right corner.
  6. Select Hide With Spoiler and Send.

How is a Spoiler Message Shown on Telegram?

If you have sent a message or image in spoiler mode, it will be shown with a moving blur cover over it in Telegram.

How do I View a Spoiler Message on Telegram?

Just tap on the spoiler message to view it on Telegram.

Is a Hidden Message and Spoiler Message the Same on Telegram?

No, hidden messages are another feature that comes under the Start Secret Chat feature on Telegram. Although you can call spoiler messages hidden texts, the Secret Chat feature and Spoiler texts are completely different tools.

We hope our guide helped you send spoiler messages on Telegram by following the methods outlined in this guide. Keep visiting TechCult for more tech-related know-how. Do not hesitate to reach out to us in the comment section.

title: How to Create Poll on Telegram
subtitle: Open Telegram, open a group to create, tap the attachment icon, choose Poll, type your question and answer options, and tap CREATE to send it
author: Techcult
summary: Open Telegram, open a group to create, tap the attachment icon, choose Poll, type your question and answer options, and tap CREATE to send it
content:
Telegram polls are an excellent tool for the active participation of the audience, as well as the opportunity to collect opinions or make a group decision. Surveys polls are engaging whether you use them in a community channel or just for fun with friends. If you are also pondering how to create a poll on Telegram, this article is for you. All right then, let’s get started and make a poll on Telegram!

  • How to Create a Poll on Telegram
  • Option 1: Within a Telegram Group
  • Option 2: Using a Poll Bot
  • How Can Polls Be Helpful?

How to Create a Poll on Telegram

Polls can be useful if you are a group admin, a businessman, or an individual who likes to have plans with friends or colleagues. Telegram polls help in starting a discussion or knowing about the participants. Below are the ways by which you can start a poll on Telegram.

Option 1: Within a Telegram Group

You can easily create a survey poll in a chat or group by following the steps below.

  1. Open the Telegram app and open the group to create a poll.
  2. Tap the attachment icon (clip icon), then choose Poll from the options.
  3. Type your question and answer options.
  4. Finally, tap CREATE to send the poll to the group.

Option 2: Using a Poll Bot

Another way to make a poll is by using the bots. For this:

  1. Open Telegram and tap the search button.
  2. In the search box, type @pollbot and search.
  3. Click the first search result and a new chat with the bot opens up.
  4. Tap Start, then tap Create New Poll.
  5. Send your question and answer options to the bot via message in the same chat.
  6. When the poll is ready, you’ll see a link.
  7. Tap the link and select the group you want to send the survey.
  8. Tap the OK button to confirm sending.

How Can Polls Be Helpful?

Telegram polls are the first choice for better discussions and interaction in the virtual space. Polls help to gather feedback and engage your Telegram community. They can be helpful in many ways.

  • Captivate Your Group Members: The main aim of creating a poll in Telegram is to engage the audience. The polls make the process more social because it gives the members an option to contribute their opinions. The audience actively takes part in the Telegram poll, thus increasing engagement.
  • Collecting Feedback: Opinion polls are the most effective way to get valuable insights and feedback from your subscribers in telegram. If you create the poll, you get real information that enables your decision-making process.
  • Effective Decision Making: Poll results are participants’ preferences based on popular trends. Therefore, audiences can help in making good and effective decisions.
  • Audience’s Active Participation: Engaging users in polls, makes them feel more important and included in the process. The overall impact is a better-engaged community.
  • Smooth Communication: Telegram polls improve the flow of communication and make the data collection process quite manageable. They are quicker and reduce the time and energy required to conduct individual surveys.

Also Read: How to Share Private Channel Link on Telegram

Polls are insightful and instantaneous means to gather public opinions.

We hope our guide helped you create a poll on Telegram. We’ll appreciate your feedback and queries regarding the topics in the comments area below. Keep visiting TechCult for more helpful and interesting how-to guides.

title: How to Share Private Channel Link on Telegram
subtitle: You can find your Telegram private channel link in the channel info page under the share link text field and then send it to your friends.
author: Techcult
summary: You can find your Telegram private channel link in the channel info page under the share link text field and then send it to your friends.
content:
You already know that Telegram allows users to create channels on the platform. Unlike groups, these offer a one-way communication stream where the admin can cover any topic of interest and share updates, media, and other content with its subscribers.

Regardless of whether it’s a public or private channel, you can create and share its links for users on Telegram to join directly and see new drops. Want to know how? We’ll guide you in today’s blog.

  • How to Share Private Channel Link on Telegram
  • Can People Find My Private Channel on Telegram?
  • How to Get a Telegram Channel Link
  • How Can I Join a Private Group in Telegram Without Link?

How to Share Private Channel Link on Telegram

Be news, technology, entertainment, hobbies, or Telegram channels for books, they cater to your interests and keep you and other members connected.

It’s a simple process to send the link to a private channel link on Telegram, increase subscribers, and boost engagement which can help your business.

1. Open Telegram and open the private channel you wish to share the link to.

2. Tap on the channel name at the top of the chat thread.

3. Long press on the channel link under share link to copy it.

4. Open the message thread of the person from any platform, long press on the screen, and tap on Paste.

Also Read: How to Share Telegram Group Link

Can People Find My Private Channel on Telegram?

No, unless you specifically invite users or share the channel link with them, they won’t be able to find your private Telegram channel even by browsing or searching. 

Only those who have received an invitation or have access to the URL can join the channel.

How to Get a Telegram Channel Link

If you wish to get a link to your group or Telegram channel, follow the steps below:

1. Open Telegram, navigate to your channel or group, and tap the channel/group profile.

2. Tap on Edit at the top right corner of the screen and then select Channel Type.

3. Tap on the link under INVITE LINK.

Also Read: Telegram Sensitive Content Option Not Showing: Proven Fix (2024)

How Can I Join a Private Group in Telegram Without Link?

If you do not have an invite link to a private channel or group on Telegram, check the following steps to join it:

1. Open any browser and type https://t.me/ followed by the name of the group. Here we have taken crypto.

2. Tap on VIEW IN TELEGRAM.

3. Tap on Join at the bottom of the group.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q1: Where to share my Telegram link?

Ans: You can share your Telegram link across any social media platform like Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, or WhatsApp to name a few.

Q2: How to Join a Private Channel in Telegram?

Ans: You can join a private channel in Telegram only by receiving an invitation link sent by the owner of the channel. Once approved, you can see messages on the private channel.

Q3: How secure is Telegram private channel?

Ans: Telegram private channels are pretty secure and all conversations and calls have end-to-end encryption for communications.

In addition, they also offer the option to auto-delete messages which ensures a non-invited user cannot see messages after they are read in the channel.

Q4: What happens if I delete a Telegram link?

Ans: Users can no longer use the link to join your group or channel if you delete the link.

Q5: Can a private Telegram channel be copyrighted?

Ans: Whether or not your channel is public, you may face legal repercussions if you distribute copyrighted content without authorization. 

We hope our guide helped you share link to your private channel on Telegram and invite your friends over effortlessly.

If you have any queries or suggestions, do reach out to us in the comment section and keep visiting TechCult for more informative guides.

title: How to Reset or Recover Forgotten Telegram Passcode on iPhone
subtitle: While there is no direct way to recover your Telegram passcode on iPhone, if you forgot it, reinstall the app to access back your chats again.
author: Techcult
summary: While there is no direct way to recover your Telegram passcode on iPhone, if you forgot it, reinstall the app to access back your chats again.
content:
Oh, so you forgot your passcode for the Telegram iOS app on iPhone and now are locked out of the app?

Don’t worry, just like any app that gives importance to the privacy and security of its users, Telegram does the same with passcodes.

However, if you set one earlier, but now have forgotten it, there is no time to wait and remember, especially when you need urgent access to your important messages.

Well, this guide will help you recover your locked account. Let’s begin.

  • What is Telegram Passcode Lock? How to Recover It If You Forgot It
  • How to Recover Forgotten Telegram Passcode on iPhone
  • Method 1: Reset via SMS Recovery Option
  • Method 2: Reset via Email Recovery Option
  • Method 3: Use Forgot Password
  • Method 4: Insert Face ID/Fingerprint as an Alternative
  • Method 5: Contact Telegram Support
  • How to Turn off Telegram Passcode on iPhone
  • Option 1: Turn the Passcode Off
  • Option 2: Change Passcode

What is Telegram Passcode Lock? How to Recover It If You Forgot It

Telegram Passcode Lock is a feature that locks the app behind a numeric PIN or biometric verification like Touch or Face ID to prevent unauthorized access to your chat threads.

Once locked, your messages won’t be accessible to anyone if you don’t input the passcode. So, you can share your phone with other people without any worries.

Unfortunately, you cannot recover or reset your passcode if you forget it.

However, to unlock your chats without the passcode you can uninstall the app and install it once again. You can reset the passcode again after the app is re-installed.

How to Recover Forgotten Telegram Passcode on iPhone

Here are the ways you can reset your Telegram passcode:

Method 1: Reset via SMS Recovery Option

You can use the Two-Step Verification SMS Recovery to reset access to your chats on Telegram: 

1. While logging in, enter your phone number and tap on Continue.

2. Enter the 6-digit activation code Telegram sends to your number.

Now you will be logged into your Telegram account via SMS code.

Method 2: Reset via Email Recovery Option

If you have enabled the Email Recovery option, you can also use this feature to reset or recover your Telegram passcode. 

1. Go to Settings > Privacy and Security.

2. Tap on Two-Step Verification, then enter your selected password and tap on Create Password.

3. Enter a Telegram Password Hint.

Note: You can also skip this step by tapping on Skip setting hint.

4. Next, enter the Recovery Email and tap on Continue.

5. Enter the code you receive in the Recovery Email to confirm your account to successfully enable it.

Once done, you will get a recovery code on the selected Email during the login process to reset your password.

Also Read: Telegram Sensitive Content Option Not Showing: Proven Fix (2024)

Method 3: Use Forgot Password

As a last resort, you can also use the Forgot password feature to reset your password

1. Go to Settings > Privacy and Security > Two-Step Verification.

2. Tap on Forgot password?

3. Enter the recovery code sent to your registered email address and then create a new password of your choice.

Method 4: Insert Face ID/Fingerprint as an Alternative

If you forgot your Telegram password, it shouldn’t be a hassle to recover it without Email. How? While enabling your Telegram passcode, put either your Face ID or Fingerprint as an alternate option.

1. Open Telegram and tap on Settings in the bottom right corner of the screen.

2. Tap on Privacy and Security from the menu and then on Passcode & Face ID.

3. Tap on Turn Passcode On and enter your selected passcode.

4. Now, turn the toggle on for Unlock with Face ID.

Method 5: Contact Telegram Support

If the said methods do not work out for you, it is best to contact the Telegram Support team and put forth your problems. 

Also Read: This Group Channel Can’t Be Displayed Error Telegram: Why and How to Fix (2024)

How to Turn off Telegram Passcode on iPhone

Do you get too many Incorrect passcode try again in 1 minute prompts on Telegram. Just rid of your old Telegram passcode or remove it altogether. 

Option 1: Turn the Passcode Off

Follow the steps to disable the passcode feature on Telegram:

1. Go to Settings > Privacy and Security > Passcode and Face ID.

2. Enter your passcode to view the settings and tap on Turn Passcode Off.

3. Once again select Turn Passcode Off to confirm your action.

Option 2: Change Passcode

If you still want to have a passcode by changing the current codes, follow these steps:

1. Follow steps 1-2 from the previous option and then tap on Change Passcode.

2. Enter your new passcode and re-enter it to confirm.

Also Read: How to Save Telegram Self-Destructing Photos: Sure Shot Method

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q1. How long does Telegram lock you out?

Ans: For security issues, Telegram will lock you out for 24 hours before trying to log in again if you have failed to enter the proper code. It is advised to wait until the allotted time is over before attempting to enter your account again to avoid being permanently banned.

Q2. What to do if I forget my two-factor authentication code Telegram?

Ans: When you first create a two-factor authentication, you also receive a recovery code sent via Telegram’s official chat. You can reset your 2-step verification password and get back into your account by using this code.

If you forgot your Telegram passcode iPhone, these fixes will surely help you recover your account.

If you have any queries or suggestions, let us know in the comment section. Keep visiting TechCult for more tech-related know-how.

content:
Telegram has undoubtedly established itself as a well-known messaging platform where apart from one-to-one chat and group conversations, users can subscribe to channels to interact with content broadcasted on it.

But, somewhere along the line, you must have run into a message that says- This group or channel can’t be displayed on Telegram when trying to join one.

Yes, it might be annoying, but, no longer.

We will show you how to fix this issue. Let’s get started.

  • Why this Group/Channel Can’t Be Displayed Prompt Appears on Telegram?
  • How to Fix This Group/Channel Can’t Be Displayed on Telegram
  • Method 1: Use Nicegram Bot
  • Method 2: Use Virtual Phone Number
  • Method 3: Use Telegram on a Different Device
  • Method 4: Try Telegram X
  • Method 5: Web Search for the Channel
  • Method 6: Contact Telegram Support

Why this Group/Channel Can’t Be Displayed Prompt Appears on Telegram?

As Telegram channels are publicly available, anyone can join it.

Although it is a plus point, difficulties arise when it comes to keeping a check on the content shared within the channel, especially with a huge number of members.

Many people use these channels to share inappropriate content or pirated media, spamming and phishing or even to spread violence and hatred messages. 

Known for security and privacy, Telegram’s sensitive content control filters remove such content and even take down such channels.

So, some of the reasons why you see the – This channel can’t be displayed message when you open one is because:

  • Sensitive or illegal content is being shared on the channel.
  • The channel is used to trade explicit or pornographic content.
  • Members on the channel are encouraging hate and violence through text, images, and videos.
  • The channel distributes copyrighted or pirated content.
  • It is being used for scams.
  • Due to violating local laws, the channel is restricted or banned.

Quick Answer

Re-log into your Telegram account or use another device. Additionally, you can also use VPN to set your location to a different region.

How to Fix This Group/Channel Can’t Be Displayed on Telegram

Follow the methods to get rid of the easy and get access to the content shared on your favorite Telegram channels and groups.

Method 1: Use Nicegram Bot

You can use the Nicegream bot to easily access inappropriate or banned content shared on the Telegram channel. 

1. Open Telegram, type Nicegram Bot in the search bar, and select it from the search results.

2. Tap on Start.

Note: You can also tap on the link given under Nicecgram Web if you do not get a Start option.

3. Tap on the Log in with Telegram option.

4. Turn the toggle on for I’m 18+ Years Old and Show content that may be sensitive and select SAVE.

You’ll get a pop-up message asking you to restart the Nicegram bot. Force-close the Telegram app to fix the channel can’t be displayed issue.

Also Read: How to Save Telegram Self-Destructing Photos: Sure Shot Method

Method 2: Use Virtual Phone Number

Restrictions on Telegram are applied based on the phone number you use to sign up for your account.

If it shows that this channel cannot be displayed because it violated local laws, that means that due to restrictions laid in that country or region, you aren’t able to access the content.

Apart from VPN, you can use a virtual phone number provider to bypass these restrictions.

Get a virtual number from a non-restricted country and create a Telegram account using it.

Method 3: Use Telegram on a Different Device

It’s sometimes the device you are using Telegram on that can cause the discussed issue because the policies to block sensitive content are imposed based on the OS. 

So, if you have multiple devices, install Telegram on them and check if the group or channel’s content is displayed now.

Also Read: How to Use Telegram Without a Phone Number

Method 4: Try Telegram X

Telegram X is an alternative version of the main Telegram app with a completely new code base, different interface, and experimental features that may be eventually rolled out to the original app. 

Download Telegram X, get a VoIP number, choose a non-restricted location, and create a new account to sign in and access the channel that wasn’t displayed earlier. 

Method 5: Web Search for the Channel

Moreover, popular Telegram channels frequently have an additional or mirror channel alongside the primary channel, which you can join to access their content.

So, either search for the backup channel, or as a workaround, use the complete channel name or URL to search it on your web browser and locate it on different platforms like Discord or forums. 

Also Read: How to Get Telegram Premium Subscription for Free

Method 6: Contact Telegram Support

Lastly, if none of the aforementioned solutions work, contact Telegram Support for help. 

We hope our guide helped you get rid of the annoying this Group can’t be displayed on Telegram prompt.

title: Do Telegram Calls Show on Phone Bill?
subtitle: No, phone bills do not show Telegram calls as it uses Wi-Fi or mobile data, and calls are routed via their servers.
author: Techcult
summary: No, phone bills do not show Telegram calls as it uses Wi-Fi or mobile data, and calls are routed via their servers.
content:
Telegram has rapidly gained popularity in recent years for its simple interface as a messaging app.

Not only this, it also offers audio and video calls, scheduled messages, custom stickers, and many more features.

Do you often use Telegram to stay in touch with your friends and wonder whether the calls show on your phone bill?

You are not alone, many users have the same question. So, let’s find out all about how Telegram may affect your phone bill.

  • Do Telegram Calls Show on Phone Bill?
  • Do you Get Charged for Telegram Calls?
  • Does Telegram Charge for International Texts?
  • Are Telegram Calls Private?
  • Is my Phone Number Hidden on Telegram?
  • Can You Call Someone on Telegram without Number?
  • Is it Safe to Use Telegram to Make Video Calls?
  • How to View Call History in Telegram
  • How to Delete Telegram Calls from Recent on Your iPhone

Do Telegram Calls Show on Phone Bill?

No, Telegram uses mobile data or Wi-Fi to make and receive calls because all calls and texts are routed via their servers.

Telegram calls do not function like regular phone calls.

However, to call anyone for free, you must have their username or contact information.

Do you Get Charged for Telegram Calls?

No, Telegram uses Wi-Fi or a cellular network to conduct calls from its platform so you will not be charged for any calls made via the app.

Does Telegram Charge for International Texts?

No, Telegram does not charge for any international calls or texts because both take place over the Internet.

So, you avoid paying any international roaming fees.

Also Read: How to Get Telegram Premium Subscription for Free

Are Telegram Calls Private?

Yes, all conversations and calls on Telegram are encrypted.

If you use the Secret Chats option, Telegram also provides end-to-end encryption for communications during one-on-one conversations.

In addition to not being able to be forwarded, Secret Chat messages have a self-destruct timer that you can turn on and off at intervals of one second to one week.

Follow the steps to enable the Secret Chat messages feature:

1. Open Telegram and open the chat of a specific user you wish to enable Secret Chat with.

2. Tap on the profile followed by three dots in the top right corner.

3. Select Start Secret Chat.

4. Select START in the pop-up window.

Your secret chat will be enabled with the user.

Is my Phone Number Hidden on Telegram?

Yes, if your privacy settings on Telegram do not permit users to view your number, it will always be hidden.

Users can view your phone number only if you have synchronized your contact list with Telegram and have other users’ phone numbers saved on your phone.

Also Read: How to Send View Once Voice and Video Messages on Telegram

Can You Call Someone on Telegram without Number?

Yes, you can call or text on Telegram without disclosing your phone number.

Users can create usernames, and you can communicate with others by sharing your username rather than your phone number.

Is it Safe to Use Telegram to Make Video Calls?

Yes, video calls are secured by end-to-end encryption on Telegram making it very safe to communicate.

How to View Call History in Telegram

You can easily view call history in Telegram.

Option 1: On Android

You can see the Telegram call history within the app.

1. Open the Telegram app and tap on the three horizontal lines.

2. Choose Calls.

Option 2: On iPhone

The calls you have made on Telegram appear in the Recent tab of call logs on your iPhone. 

You can also see the recent calls within the app.

1. Open Telegram and tap on Settings at the bottom left corner.

2. Tap on Recent Calls from the menu.

How to Delete Telegram Calls from Recent on Your iPhone

If you wish to delete certain calls from your recent activity from your iPhone, follow the steps mentioned below:

1. Go to the Recent calls tab by following the steps above.

2. Swipe left on the call of your choice and tap on Delete.

3. Select between Delete for Everyone and Delete for Me.

Now, your call will be deleted from the Recents tab on Telegram.

Also Read: How to Know If Someone Saved Your Number on Telegram

Now that you have figured out everything about Telegram calls shown on your phone bill, enjoy unlimited calls without any worries.

If you have any queries or suggestions, don’t hesitate to drop them in the comment section.

Keep visiting TechCult for more tech guides!

content:
Snapchat has evolved from more than just a selfie app. Did you know that you can also play fun games with your friends on the platform? So, if you are bored or looking for new ways to pass your time, here are some of the best Snapchat games you have to play and see for yourself! Let’s get started!

  • 26+ Best Snapchat Games You Have to Play
  • 1. Subway Surfers Airtime
  • 2. Chess Quest
  • 3. Zombie Rescue Squad
  • 4. Cube Surfer
  • 5. Crazy Run
  • 6. Super Snappy Bowling
